items.text:
Writing as of 0.14. TL;DR: It has issues, but if this sounds like your type of game, it is!
It's got bugs. You'll get the debug menu about items disappearing or other issues. The game has a memory leak and stutters more the longer you play. The UI is a pain to use later on and every time you do anything that pops up its own screen, it closes your inventory and you have to open it back up and reorganize everything. The tutorial also actively puts you in a position to get a hefty fine for illegally salvaging and you'll have no idea.
I bring up the issues because beyond all of its faults, Ostranauts is a blast! The world doesn't care about you, but isn't actively out to get you. You can die relatively easily from small, stupid mistakes. You can die from larger stupid mistakes (like go to sleep on your ship to save from paying for a docking fee, and find your ship has drifted off hours away from KLEG, the starting station). But the game is very fair and reasonable. You can thrive with some considerations. You can get lucky early on and find very high value items or keep stumbling across small, destroyed ships with little to profit from. And it's all a delight because your success is completely on you. Along with that, there's a huge amount of stations out there in space and plenty to discover. Or you can do like me and spend nearly all of your 100+ hours around the starting station. 
The atmosphere of the game is a delight. Trying to figure out if it's worth trying to cram more stuff into your ship to haul back and sell is a delight. Spending the time to repair the items or just sell them broken or in poor condition so you can get back out there is a fun decision. And the Newtonian physics of piloting ships is intimidating at first, but is surprisingly easy to manage once you get your feet wet. 
There's a lot of tips and suggestions to start, but I recommend just diving in for your first character. Make some mistakes and enjoy finding out how to screw yourself, which are fair and make sense where you go wrong. And after an NPC slams themselves into you at 1000km/s which makes you slam into Ganymede, instantly killing you, feel free to start a new character to start with a better understanding or go back to before you died and work on the faults you have going on. There's tons of content between trading, salvaging, flipping ships, building a reactor, flying off to other planets and stations, getting friendly with the authorities and pirates, and perhaps getting into the struggle that forms as you play.
items.text_zh:
写于0.14版本。长话短说：它有问题，但如果这听起来像是你会喜欢的游戏类型，那它就是！
它有bug。你会看到关于物品消失或其他问题的调试菜单。游戏有内存泄漏，玩得越久卡顿越严重。后期UI用起来很痛苦，每次你做任何会弹出自己界面的操作时，它都会关闭你的库存，你得重新打开并重新整理所有东西。教程还会主动把你置于因非法打捞而被重罚的境地，而你根本不会知道。
我提出这些问题是因为，尽管有所有这些缺点，Ostranauts真是太棒了！这个世界不在乎你，但也不会主动针对你。你可能因为小而愚蠢的错误相对容易地死掉。你也可能因为更大的愚蠢错误而死掉（比如为了省下停靠费而在你的船上睡觉，结果发现你的船已经漂离KLEG——起始空间站——好几个小时远）。但游戏非常公平合理。只要有所考虑，你就能兴旺发达。你可以在早期走运找到价值极高的物品，或者不断偶遇几乎没什么可赚的小型残骸飞船。而这一切都令人愉快，因为你的成功完全取决于你自己。除此之外，太空中还有大量空间站和许多可发现的东西。或者你可以像我一样，把100多个小时几乎全花在起始空间站附近。
游戏的氛围令人愉快。试图弄清楚是否值得往你的船里塞更多东西运回去卖掉，是一种愉快。花时间修理物品，还是把它们以损坏或状况不佳的状态卖掉以便能重新出发，是一个有趣的抉择。而驾驶飞船的牛顿物理学一开始令人望而生畏，但一旦你下水尝试，管理起来会出奇地容易。
一开始有很多提示和建议，但我建议你的第一个角色就直接跳进去。犯一些错误，享受发现如何把自己搞砸的过程，这些错误是公平的，而且能让你明白自己错在哪里。当某个NPC以1000公里/秒撞上你，让你撞上木卫三，瞬间杀死你之后，你可以随意新建一个角色，以更好的理解重新开始，或者回到你死之前，去处理你存在的问题。在贸易、打捞、倒卖飞船、建造反应堆、飞往其他行星和空间站、与当局和海盗交好，以及可能卷入随着游玩而形成的斗争中，有大量内容。

items.text:
Really interesting. I personally haven't run into any major bugs, had to reload a save a few times and such but nothing I couldn't recover from. Doesn't do a great job of explaining some aspects of gameplay, but I can't tell if that is EA issues, or if fumbling around and dying a few times in really dumb ways is intended gameplay, if it is, I'm not mad at it.

Nice mix of building and adventure in a simulated solar system. I'd love to see this game grow, ship to ship combat would be tight with this orbital flight system, but even as it stands there is a lot of fun to be had.

Is rather fiddly, the UI isn't dwarf fortress levels of complex, but it isn't simple, it wont warn you before you do stupid things, so ya gotta pay attention and make sure your selecting the right parts, and the right options, the first time.

真的很有意思。我个人还没遇到什么重大bug，有过几次不得不重新读档之类的情况，但都不是我恢复不了的。游戏对某些玩法方面的解释做得不太好，但我分不清这是抢先体验版的问题，还是说四处乱摸、以一些非常愚蠢的方式死上几次就是有意设计的玩法，如果是的话，我也不生气。

在模拟太阳系中建造和冒险的绝佳结合。我很想看到这款游戏成长，用这套轨道飞行系统进行飞船对飞船的战斗会很带感，但即使就目前这样，也有很多乐趣可享。

items.text:
Ostranauts is a top down 2d space scavenger game with ship building mechanics and a simple atmosphere and orbital dynamics simulator. It also looks like there is the intent to have heat simulation and some crew interaction simulation. There is a hypothetical long range travel,  but its bugged out of any usefulness and despite dozens of attempts I failed to make the autopilot get me anywhere near anywhere else. Note that you have to use the autopilot as you cannot manually use the long range drive. That the characters die unless you manually feed them every few hours also make long distance travel atrociously annoying. It would be so simple to have them auto consume food, water and sleep when fast forwarding, but instead they just randomly die. 

and cant really say anything about it. The main game loop consists of scavenging various derelicts and building up your ship, and paying of the loans you have on the starting ship, avoiding spending too much on fuel and oxygen. This aspect is somewhat fun, but the main difficulty of the game is essentially remembering where you stored something. This makes building and repair with spare parts tedious. It would be a good idea to keep track of only a few kinds of mechanically different floors, and keep the texture of the floor separate from the type, and the same holds for walls. The shipbuilding is fun but due to storage mechanics rather tedious. The power mechanics are very opaque and there is no way to see how much something will draw. There is a system for character progression, well maybe, it still levels up the skills you already have, and when they finally reach 100% you never get anything for it, but it does look like its there... The amount of work needed is also wildly varying and disproportionate. Combat and conversation is lousy, again mostly due to bad ui. It would be better if you entered into a  different kind of menu for it, rather than needing to scroll around and guess what things do. 

There should also be difficulty related to managing food, drink and atmosphere and heat, but these systems are nearly trivial to maintain, or bugged. There is also no recycling of food drink wast etc, no greenhouses, and strangely no solar panels or radio isotope generators. The occasional loss of power, or fuel, or crashing nav station are all fun things mini events but can be a bit too punishing in some cases. 

There is an interesting character creation process, but its rather limited, and without knowing what anything does its less fun. 

The problem is the bugs. Bugs like your character equiping a space helmet for no clear reason and then falling unconsious once the air runs out while inside your ship where the atmosphere is fine. Bugs like the various character status bars being difficult to intrepet, or again bugged. Bugs like not needing to go to the bathroom for months before suddenly nearly dying due to not having been in the last few minutes over and over again. Bugs like station personel dropping like flies if you stick around for a few hours, leaving their valuables behind.  Bugs like losing the ability to left click on things, which is the main mode of interaction, bugs like the character randomly committing suicide in various ways. The game is also astonishingly slow to load and save which is the only way to fix most bugs. Please upgrade to protobufs with an arena and stop using zipped jsons... Also the game badly needs longer range for a* when searching for valid paths and valid haul locations. 

The game is really promising, but just not ready for release yet. If you are willing to live with alot of unintuitive ui, jank the game is fun as is, but it still needs alot of work.
items.text_zh:
《Ostranauts》是一款俯视视角的2D太空打捞游戏，带有飞船建造机制，以及一个简单的大气与轨道动力学模拟器。看起来它还打算加入热量模拟和一些船员互动模拟。游戏里有一种假想中的远距离航行，但它已经bug到毫无用处，尽管我尝试了几十次，还是没能让自动驾驶把我带到任何其他地方附近。注意，你必须使用自动驾驶，因为你无法手动使用远距离驱动器。角色除非你每隔几小时手动喂他们一次，否则就会死，这也让远距离航行变得极其烦人。在快进时让他们自动消耗食物、水和睡觉本该是件很简单的事，但他们却只会随机死掉。

而且对此真的没什么可说的。主游戏循环包括打捞各种废弃飞船、逐步建造自己的飞船、偿还你在初始飞船上的贷款，同时避免在燃料和氧气上花太多钱。这方面还算有点意思，但游戏的主要难点本质上就是记住你把某样东西放在哪里了。这让用备用零件进行建造和修理变得很繁琐。只追踪少数几种在机制上不同的地板，并把地板贴图与类型分开，会是个好主意，墙壁也是如此。造船很有趣，但由于存储机制而相当繁琐。电力机制非常不透明，而且没有办法看到某样东西会消耗多少电。有一个角色成长系统，嗯，也许吧，它仍然会提升你已经拥有的技能，而当它们终于达到100%时，你什么也得不到，但它看起来确实存在……所需的工作量也变化极大且不成比例。战斗和对话很糟糕，同样主要是因为糟糕的UI。如果进入一种不同类型的菜单来处理这些，而不是需要四处滚动并猜测东西是干什么的，那会更好。

还应该有与管理食物、饮水、大气和热量相关的难度，但这些系统维护起来几乎微不足道，或者就是有bug。也没有食物、饮水、废物等的回收利用，没有温室，而且奇怪的是没有太阳能板或放射性同位素发电机。偶尔的断电、断燃料或导航站崩溃都是有趣的迷你事件，但在某些情况下可能惩罚过重。

有一个有趣的角色创建过程，但它相当有限，而且在不知道任何东西是干什么的情况下，乐趣也会减少。

问题在于bug。比如你的角色毫无明确理由地装备上太空头盔，然后在空气耗尽后失去意识，而当时你还在自己飞船内部，那里的大气明明没问题。比如各种角色状态条难以解读，或者同样有bug。比如几个月都不需要上厕所，然后突然因为过去几分钟内没上过厕所而反复濒临死亡。比如如果你在某个地方待上几个小时，空间站人员就会像苍蝇一样倒下，留下他们的贵重物品。比如失去左键点击物体的能力，而这是主要的交互方式；比如角色以各种方式随机自杀。游戏加载和保存也慢得惊人，而这是修复大多数bug的唯一方法。请升级到带arena的protobuf，别再使用压缩的json了……另外，游戏在搜索有效路径和有效拖运位置时，非常需要为A*提供更长的搜索范围。

这款游戏真的很有前景，但还没准备好发布。如果你愿意忍受大量不直观的UI和粗糙感，游戏目前这样也挺好玩，但它仍然需要大量工作。

items.text:
One of the few games that compensates for lack of fancy graphics, 3D world or friendly UI with sheer gameplay. You salvage, you build, you earn and survive, all aboard veritable coffins that are proudly called 'spacecrafts'.

UI needs work, inventory needs a remake, learning curve needs a bit more help, character interractions can be a confusing mess, crew can be borderline unusable and NPCs are suicidal, yet despite that game is fun and keeps getting updates.

items.text:
when i played the demo, years ago, i was left with a... pretty bad first impression.

the controls were wonky, the user interface was opaque, and i couldn't really tell what i was meant to be doing.

it left enough of an impression on me that even as early access progressed, even as additional updates rolled out, even as it went on sale, even as one of my friends played it and reported on what those updates played like, i kept going "..... i dunno."

then after 0.14 hit, something happened in my social circles: people started playing the game, and i got a [i]wildly[/i] different impression on the state of the game than i did even just from 0.13, the very previous update.

with the addition of venus, there was somewhere to strive to get [i]to[/i]. with the rework of the reactor system, there was something to strive to [i]have[/i]. these elements, along with a lot of other adjustments and fixes, helped provide a better framing that let all of the systems work of the previous updates suddenly be recontextualized, and now, as if by magic, we went from "a kinda interesting simulation, i guess" to [b]an actual game[/b].

is the ui still kinda opaque? yeah. are there weird systems interactions that are counterintuitive? oh yeah. are there bugs? most definitely.

but the progress i'm seeing makes me believe that the team has a better understanding of what they need to clean up for the upcoming 1.0 release, and i wanna see it happen.
items.text_zh:
当我多年前玩这个演示版时，我留下的第一印象……相当糟糕。

操作很别扭，用户界面晦涩难懂，我根本搞不清自己该做什么。

它给我留下的印象如此之深，以至于即使抢先体验不断推进，即使额外更新陆续推出，即使它开始打折，即使我的一个朋友玩了它并反馈了那些更新的游玩体验，我一直都在说“..... 我不知道。”

然后0.14版本发布后，我的社交圈里发生了一些事：人们开始玩这个游戏，而我对游戏状态的印象与仅仅从0.13，也就是上一个更新中得到的印象[i]截然不同[/i]。

随着金星的加入，有了一个可以努力[i]前往[/i]的地方。随着反应堆系统的重做，有了可以努力[i]拥有[/i]的东西。这些元素，连同许多其他调整和修复，帮助提供了一个更好的框架，让之前所有更新的系统工作突然被重新赋予了意义，而现在，仿佛魔法一般，我们从“一个还算有趣的模拟，我猜”变成了[b]一个真正的游戏[/b]。

用户界面还是有点晦涩吗？是的。有没有奇怪的系统交互让人反直觉？哦，有的。有没有bug？绝对有。

但我看到的进步让我相信，团队更清楚地知道他们需要为即将到来的1.0发布清理什么，而我想看到它实现。

items.text: It's not a bad game by any means but it has so many stuff going on at the same time and there is no pacing. You get bombarded by everything at the same time which is a nightmare. Even after playing it for some time you still have no idea whats going on. You create a character with 0 idea whats going on you get on your ship with 0 idea of whats going on. You start figuring stuff out while scavenging. You come back to the station still not knowing what you should do. Is the amount you made any good. Do i upgrade the ship. Do i keep the money for the debt? Is there a docking fee? What's an eva? Why and where do i charge it? What is a shuttle? Why is ui design so complicated? What the ♥♥♥♥ is going on with the very complicated and retarded dialogue systems. Do i dismantle or just bring the stuff in. Why is navigating the space sucks so much etc. There is a ♥♥♥♥ ton of problems. Very hostile against new player. If they don't abandon the game they will eventually figure out stuff and it will become a great game. Right now if you know what you are doing its fun but if you are not ready to watch a couple hours of videos to get ready and you are not okay with 1 mistake ruining your whole game. Don't even try it. You can softlock the game by just playing it and lose an hour of progress.

items.text:
[h1]Not recommended[/h1]
[h2]Decent spaceflight component, but ground game is weak and worsened by abysmal documentation. Early access so may improve, but needs work and is in rough shape as of September 2024.[/h2]

This is a game I dearly wanted to like. Despite having problems with Neo Scavenger years back to the point where I put it aside and have yet to pick it back up, I bought this game (thankfully on sale) because it looked good.
It might be good. Unfortunately, there's no way to really tell.

[h2]It aims for the stars...[/h2]
This game aims high. It wants to be a highly detailed simulation (excellent) of spaceflight and salvage (even better) and gives you the opportunity to not just buy but customize and even build ships (now we're talking). 

[h3]Great spaceflight component [/h3]
The spaceflight is magnificent, with strong overtones of Apollo and Space Shuttle controls and mechanics but suitably sci-fi. It feels [i]real[/i], and that's a rarity in a casual, non-simulation title. It's suitably gritty and requires patience and precision, and it doesn't really lend itself to being incautious - but you have the freedom to be if you so choose.

[h2]...and misses in almost every way.[/h2]
Unfortunately, that's where the praise is going to end because the game as it stands is barely playable for several reasons. 
[h3]Zero documentation [/h3]
First of all, there's no documentation. No, I don't count a half-assembled wiki full of things the average player can intuit as documentation, and zero points for having a Discord. The "player manual" is five pages and almost all of them are useless. There's a tutorial, but although it gives you tasks to complete it [i]explains[/i] very little, leaving you to learn everything by trial and error. Beginner area? None, you're in the deep end from the start. Training period, guidance, anything of the sort? Just the bare-bones tutorial. (Great, I've created a zone out of a patch of random floor... why did I do that?) So you're left to figure out this detailed game on your own. There are fan-made guides on Steam that are doing a better job as manuals for this game than the developers are providing. Not good.
[h3]Weak ground game, unbelievably flawed task execution [/h3]
As good as the spaceflight is, that's how bad things are once you're on the ground. The UI is, to be polite, a wreck. It's overcomplicated and under-designed. In the tutorial, you're shown how to repair something. Okay, good. But applying that lesson to a broken pump I took off of my first derelict, my character proceded to [i]walk out an airlock into hard vacuum without a helmet on.[/i] Why? Because he needed mechanical parts and went to get them. Automatically. In space. Without a helmet. Quickly steered him back inside only for him to... [i]do it again.[/i]. Because he has to be manually told to cancel all of his tasks or he's going to keep trying to go back to auto the moment your manual inputs are done. So, yeah, not the best design and it really doesn't get better. Want to open up a floor storage bin? Click on it... and get the controls for a pump instead. Turns out you have to keep right-clicking to cycle items on (or near) that tile. Would've been helpful if that'd been covered in the tutorial. Too dark to see? Turn on your worklight. It's still too dark. Why? Because the light needs to be held, not clipped to your suit. I have a worklight I use all the time. You clip it to your belt and it lights up your work area. This is lost technology in the future.
[h3]No explanations for critical gameplay components [/h3]
Many things are alluded to but never explained or in any way apparent. Got hit with a $15,000 fine for illegal salvage, ending my game before it really started because I was already in debt from my ship and couldn't pay for fuel or fees. I know you can buy a permit to salvage legally but I've yet to find [i]where or how[/i]. Went to the wiki to find out, only to be told what a permit is (I knew that much). Bad documentation strikes again. There's combat in the game, but you're not told what's involved, there's no tutorial on those mechanics at all, and the UI is as opaque for those tasks as it is for every other, so good luck. When I got mugged, I kept tackling and whacking him with a hacksaw (because punching him wasn't doing a thing) until he finally agreed to surrender... and two minutes later he died, which is expected when you beat someone with a hacksaw in space, but was there a better way? Maybe? No way to know. 
[h3]Weak graphics for walking section [/h3]
And this is a [i]very[/i] minor gripe because I generally don't really care about graphics compared to gameplay, but the ground-game graphics are so atrocious they deserve mention. They wouldn't have flown in the late 1990s, let alone the 2020s. This isn't a retro pixel style. It's just plain bad. 

[h2]The Bottom Line[/h2]
This is a game that [i]should[/i] be at least good if not outstanding, and maybe with time and some more work it will be. I really do hope so. But for right now, the obtuse, clunky UI design and lack of meaningful documentation or tooltips means that playing it is more frustrating than fulfilling. This is a thumbs-down I really feel bad about because there's a lot of promise here and it's clear there's passion behind its development, but until some of the problems are fixed and the game goes through some more revisions, it's just not there yet.
items.text_zh:
[h1]不推荐[/h1]
[h2]太空飞行部分尚可，但地面玩法薄弱，且因糟糕透顶的文档而雪上加霜。抢先体验版，所以可能会改进，但需要打磨，截至2024年9月仍处于粗糙状态。[/h2]

这是一款我非常想喜欢的游戏。尽管多年前玩《Neo Scavenger》时遇到问题，以至于我把它搁置一旁至今未再拾起，我还是买了这款游戏（幸好是在打折时），因为它看起来不错。
它可能确实不错。不幸的是，根本无法真正判断。

[h2]它志在星辰……[/h2]
这款游戏目标远大。它想成为一款高度精细的太空飞行与打捞模拟（很棒），甚至更好，并且让你不仅能够购买，还能定制甚至建造飞船（这才像话）。

[h3]出色的太空飞行部分[/h3]
太空飞行非常壮观，带有强烈的阿波罗和航天飞机操控与机制的色彩，但又恰如其分地科幻。它感觉[i]真实[/i]，这在休闲、非模拟类游戏中实属罕见。它恰如其分地粗粝，需要耐心和精确，并不真正适合鲁莽行事——但如果你愿意，你有自由去鲁莽。

[h2]……却几乎在各方面都失手了。[/h2]
不幸的是，赞美到此为止，因为就目前而言，这款游戏由于几个原因几乎无法游玩。
[h3]零文档[/h3]
首先，没有文档。不，我不把那种拼凑了一半、满是普通玩家都能凭直觉猜到的东西的wiki算作文档，有Discord也一分不值。“玩家手册”只有五页，而且几乎全是没用的。有个教程，但尽管它给你任务去完成，它[i]解释[/i]的东西却极少，让你只能通过反复试错来学习一切。新手区？没有，你从一开始就身处深水区。训练期、引导、任何类似的东西？只有那个骨瘦如柴的教程。（太好了，我用一块随机地板创建了一个区域……我为什么要那样做？）所以你只能靠自己摸索这款细节丰富的游戏。Steam上有玩家自制的指南，作为这款游戏的手册，它们比开发者提供的做得更好。不妙。
[h3]薄弱的地面玩法，难以置信地有缺陷的任务执行[/h3]
太空飞行有多好，一旦你到了地面上，事情就有多糟。UI，说得客气点，就是一塌糊涂。它过度复杂且设计不足。在教程中，你被展示了如何修理某样东西。好，不错。但当我把这一课应用到我从第一艘废弃飞船上拆下来的一个坏泵上时，我的角色竟然[i]没戴头盔就走出了气闸，进入了硬真空。[/i]为什么？因为他需要机械零件，就去拿了。自动地。在太空里。没戴头盔。我赶紧把他引回舱内，结果他又……[i]做了一次。[/i]因为他必须被手动告知取消所有任务，否则一旦你的手动输入结束，他就会一直试图回到自动模式。所以，是的，不是最好的设计，而且真的没有变好。想打开一个地板储物箱？点击它……结果却得到了一个泵的控制界面。原来你必须不断右键点击来循环切换那个格子（或附近）上的物品。如果教程里讲过这个就好了。太黑看不见？打开你的工作灯。还是太黑。为什么？因为灯需要手持，而不是夹在你的宇航服上。我有一盏一直用的工作灯。你把它夹在腰带上，它就能照亮你的工作区域。这在未来是失落的技术。
[h3]对关键玩法组件毫无解释[/h3]
许多东西被暗示，但从未被解释，或以任何方式显而易见。因为非法打捞被罚了15,000美元，游戏还没真正开始就结束了，因为我已经因飞船而负债，付不起燃料费或费用。我知道你可以购买许可证来合法打捞，但我还没找到[i]在哪里或如何[/i]购买。去wiki查，结果只告诉我许可证是什么（这我早就知道）。糟糕的文档再次作祟。游戏里有战斗，但没人告诉你涉及什么，完全没有关于这些机制的教程，而且UI对这些任务和其他所有任务一样晦涩难懂，所以祝你好运。当我被抢劫时，我一直擒抱并用钢锯猛击他（因为用拳头打他毫无作用），直到他终于同意投降……两分钟后他死了，在太空里用钢锯把人打成这样是意料之中的，但有更好的办法吗？也许有？无从得知。
[h3]步行部分的画面很差[/h3]
这是一个[i]非常[/i]小的抱怨，因为与玩法相比，我通常不太在乎画面，但地面玩法的画面实在太糟糕了，值得一提。它们在20世纪90年代末都拿不出手，更别说2020年代了。这不是复古像素风格。就是纯粹的差。

[h2]底线[/h2]
这是一款[i]本应[/i]至少不错、甚至出色的游戏，也许随着时间和更多打磨，它会变得出色。我真的希望如此。但就目前而言，晦涩、笨拙的UI设计以及缺乏有意义的文档或工具提示，意味着玩它比满足更令人沮丧。这个差评我真的给得很难受，因为这里有很多潜力，而且其开发背后显然有热情，但在一些问题得到修复、游戏经过更多修订之前，它就是还没达到那个水平。
未来的科技。
[h3]对关键玩法组件毫无解释[/h3]
许多东西被暗示，却从未被解释，也以任何方式都看不出来。因为非法打捞被罚了15,000美元，我的游戏还没真正开始就结束了，因为我已经因为飞船而负债，付不起燃料费或各种费用。我知道你可以买许可证来合法打捞，但我至今还没找到[i]在哪里或怎么买[/i]。去wiki查，结果只被告知许可证是什么（这我早就知道了）。糟糕的文档又一次发威。游戏里有战斗，但没人告诉你涉及什么，完全没有关于这些机制的教程，而且UI对这些任务来说和其他一切一样晦涩难懂，所以祝你好运。当我被抢劫时，我不断擒抱他并用钢锯猛砸他（因为用拳头打他根本没用），直到他终于同意投降……两分钟后他死了，在太空里用钢锯把人打成这样，这也在意料之中，但有没有更好的办法？也许有？无从得知。
[h3]步行部分画面孱弱[/h3]
这是一个[i]非常[/i]小的抱怨，因为比起玩法，我一般真的不太在乎画面，但地面游戏的画面实在太糟糕了，值得一提。这种画面在1990年代末都拿不出手，更别说2020年代了。这不是复古像素风格。就是单纯的烂。

[h2]总结[/h2]
这是一款[i]本应[/i]至少不错、甚至出色的游戏，也许随着时间和更多打磨，它会变得如此。我真的希望如此。但就目前而言，晦涩、笨拙的UI设计，以及缺乏有意义的文档或提示，意味着玩它比满足更令人沮丧。这是一个我真的很遗憾给出的差评，因为这里有很多潜力，而且很明显其开发背后有热情，但在一些问题被修复、游戏经过更多修订之前，它就是还不行。

items.text:
Followed the tutorial prompts, trying to hunt down which of the many small numbers and readouts the game bombards you with were relevant to the task at hand when I died from lack of oxygen. I get that the game is attempting to be hardcore and an intricate simulation, but there is a point at which difficulty and intricacy stops being "Fun" and starts being "Tedious".

Maybe if the game eases up on new players someday I might pick it up again, because it does look and seem interesting as a simulation game, but as it stands the learning cost of entry is not worth what I experienced in my time of play. Dying with no credible warning isn't a learning experience, it's a quitting moment, and a warning at the start mentioning that your first few runs will end quickly doesn't excuse bad tutorial design.
items.text_zh:
跟着教程提示走，正试图从游戏向你狂轰滥炸的众多小数字和读数中找出哪些与当前任务相关时，我因缺氧而死。我明白这游戏想走硬核路线，想做复杂的模拟，但难度和复杂到了一定程度就不再是“有趣”，而是“繁琐”了。

也许哪天游戏对新手友好些了，我可能会再捡起来，因为它作为模拟游戏看起来确实挺有意思，但就目前而言，入门的学习成本不值得我在这段游玩时间里所经历的一切。在没有可信警告的情况下死亡不是学习体验，而是让人退坑的瞬间，而且开头警告说你的头几次游玩会很快结束，这并不能为糟糕的教程设计开脱。

I started the tutorial and followed the step by step prompts. A bit confusing but I'm sure I can learn it in time.
I do love the feel of the game and the detail.
However, as I was just maybe 5 to 10  minutes into the tutorial I suddenly ran out of oxogen in my ship and died.

I get that there are many systems to get aquainted with but just this brief of time into learning the game I am dead.

items.text:
( Reviewing Ver 0.13 7/25/24, game will likely have changed with updates )

Controls 7 / 10 ( Think Old School Retro without the game pad )
Depth 9.5 / 10 ( Very Few games go this in depth, and even less do it this well though it could use some better GUI's )
Music 8 / 10 (it's pretty good, not AAA, but definalty A, now if only it didn't randomly stop playing for long periods. )
Sound effects 5 / 10 ( Some of these are ear grating and realisticly annoying meaning you'd better pay attention to that alarm that's bugging you or you might end up dead really soon )
Difficulty 9.0 / 10 (Expect to die alot until you learn, though things do get easier)
Newb Friendliness 2 / 10 ( nope expect to die alot )
Tutorial 5 / 10 ( it's there at first, just enough to get you into a position where you can die and then your on your own, Have Fun ^_^ , did i mention the tutorial sets you up to die the first time you fly?)

**The tutorial starts ship flight by having you burn up an excessive amount of your fuel before sending you out to start your first scrap, but it leaves you with so little fuel that on your return trip you are almost certain to run out before returning to dock. I've practiced several runs to see about finding a way, perhaps if i could minimize the fuel usage... My success rate for that has been roughly 1/3 and only survive if choosing the nearest scrap heap that a patrol is sure to find me scrapping and fine me 15,000 credits for the 5,000 credit license you can't really afford on your first run. Unless you let your character reach 30-40 years old before starting which carries it's own deadly problems. Just saying though a tutorial shouldn't sabotage you. That's just EVIL !**

This game is for those who like overcoming hard Challenges, sometimes blatantly unfair ones in a dystopian society. if that's not you move on.

This game is a challenging Shipbuilding / ship-scrapping game in which your character is born on an asteroid with pathetic gravity and poor personal health find themselves in a dire situation and hoping to make a better situation for themselves they dream about owning their own ship, going where they please, and earning by scrapping. It is a Dystopian Future with semi-realistic technologies. Vanilla game has a harsh economy and more than likely you will either have to start out with a large debt you struggle to keep up the payments on for your first ship or you will end up a wanted criminal, take your pick but be warned escaping the law isn't as easy as you might expect from most space games as all starter ships are limited in range, speed, and distance. They also tend to lack the tools needed to sustain the life of your crew, even basic things like a toilet and sink are considered luxuries not found on starter vessels.

This ships are highly customize-able with enough time and effort and money..... expect to die... ALOT..
Think your safe because you made it to your ship.. think again...
items.text_zh:
（评测版本 0.13 7/25/24，游戏很可能已随更新发生变化）

操控 7 / 10（想象一下没有游戏手柄的老派复古风格）
深度 9.5 / 10（很少有游戏能达到这种深度，能做到这么好的就更少了，尽管它可以用一些更好的图形界面）
音乐 8 / 10（相当不错，不是3A级别，但绝对是A级，要是它不会随机长时间停止播放就好了。）
音效 5 / 10（其中一些刺耳且现实得令人烦躁，意味着你最好注意那个烦你的警报，否则你可能很快就会死掉）
难度 9.0 / 10（在你学会之前，预计会死很多次，不过事情确实会变得容易些）
新手友好度 2 / 10（不行，预计会死很多次）
教程 5 / 10（一开始是有的，刚好够把你带到一个会死的位置，然后你就得靠自己了，玩得开心 ^_^，我有没有提到教程会让你第一次飞行时就注定要死？）

**教程开始飞船飞行时，会让你烧掉过量的燃料，然后才把你送出去开始你的第一次打捞，但它留给你的燃料少得可怜，以至于在返程途中你几乎肯定会在返回码头之前耗尽燃料。我练习了好几次，想看看能不能找到办法，也许如果我能把燃料消耗降到最低……我这样做的成功率大约是1/3，而且只有选择最近的废料堆才能活下来，而巡逻队肯定会发现我在打捞，并因为你那第一次航行中根本负担不起的5,000信用点许可证而罚你15,000信用点。除非你让你的角色在开始前活到30-40岁，而这又带有它自己致命的麻烦。只是说一句，教程不应该坑你。那简直就是邪恶！**

这款游戏适合那些喜欢克服艰难挑战的人，有时是在反乌托邦社会中那些公然不公平的挑战。如果你不是这种人，那就别玩了。

这是一款富有挑战性的造船/拆船游戏，你的角色出生在一颗重力可怜、个人健康状况糟糕的小行星上，发现自己身处绝境，并希望为自己创造更好的处境，梦想拥有自己的飞船，去自己想去的地方，靠打捞赚钱。这是一个拥有半写实技术的反乌托邦未来。原版游戏经济严酷，你很可能要么一开始就背负一大笔债务，为你的第一艘飞船苦苦维持还款，要么最终成为一名通缉犯，随你选，但要注意，逃脱法律并不像你可能从大多数太空游戏中预期的那样容易，因为所有初始飞船在航程、速度和距离上都有限。它们往往还缺乏维持船员生命所需的工具，甚至连马桶和水槽这样的基本设施都被视为初始飞船上没有的奢侈品。

这些飞船在足够的时间、精力和金钱下是高度可定制的……预计会死……很多次……
你以为到了自己的飞船上就安全了……再想想……

items.text:
I wish there was a middle-ground review option beyond yes/no. This game has a really interesting premise, unfortunately marred by some very frustrating design decisions.

TLDR: Pretty frustrating to play right now, but a ton of great worldbuilding and a great art style. With some UX improvements, this could become a phenomenal game.

The fully diegetic interfaces are pretty opaque in terms of communicating gameplay functions. Tooltips are nowhere to be found. The interfaces are clearly crafted with a lot of care for the game's universe, but from a game design perspective, it falls short of creating a cohesive experience. Often it feels detached from the core gameplay of exploring and salvaging, like you've got to "deal with" using these opaque interfaces to get to the parts of the game that are actually fun.

Inventory and item management are pretty rough IMO. Nothing has tooltips, and what your character has equipped is handled with a single paper doll, with very little feedback about how things can be equipped or managed. This is solveable, but in it's current state, the UX left a lot to be desired.

Building & crafting also confused me. From the start, you have a HUGE catalog of things you can build. But why is everything unlocked from the start? You're telling me my 20 year old asthmatic ship salvager also *happens* to know how to build 12 different kinds of bulkhead storage bin? Furthermore, the crafting loop is pretty opaque too. Blueprints can be placed, but there was no clear way to actually craft things from what I could tell.

The core point of my review is that *more feedback to the user is essential.* Let the **consequences** of gameplay remain hardcore AF. Just give the user more information about what actions can be taken, and maybe rework the crafting loop to be more incrementally unlocked and guided.
items.text_zh:
我希望除了“是/否”之外，还能有一个折中的评测选项。这款游戏有一个非常有趣的前提设定，可惜被一些极其令人沮丧的设计决策给毁了。

长话短说：目前玩起来相当令人沮丧，但世界观构建非常出色，美术风格也很棒。如果能改进一些用户体验，这可能会成为一款现象级的游戏。

完全叙事内化的界面在传达玩法功能方面相当晦涩。提示框根本找不到。这些界面显然是为了游戏宇宙而精心打造的，但从游戏设计的角度来看，它未能营造出连贯统一的体验。很多时候，它感觉与探索和打捞的核心玩法脱节，就好像你不得不“忍受”使用这些晦涩的界面，才能到达游戏中真正有趣的部分。

在我看来，物品栏和物品管理相当粗糙。什么都没有提示框，你的角色装备了什么只靠一个纸娃娃来呈现，关于如何装备或管理物品的反馈极少。这是可以解决的，但在目前的状态下，用户体验还有很多不足之处。

建造和制作也让我很困惑。从一开始，你就有一个巨大的可建造物品目录。但为什么所有东西从一开始就解锁了？你是说，我这个20岁患有哮喘的飞船打捞员，还*恰好*知道怎么建造12种不同的舱壁储物箱？此外，制作循环也相当晦涩。蓝图可以放置，但据我所知，并没有明确的方法真正用它们来制作东西。

我评测的核心观点是，*给用户更多反馈至关重要。* 让玩法的**后果**保持硬核到爆。只要给用户更多关于可以采取哪些行动的信息，也许再重新设计一下制作循环，让它以更循序渐进的方式解锁并提供引导。

observations.description: 制作循环不清晰，无法明确从蓝图制作物品
observations.evidence: Blueprints can be placed, but there was no clear way to actually craft things from what I could tell.
observations.evidence_zh: 蓝图可以放置，但据我所知，并没有明确的方法来实际制作东西。

items.text_zh:
本来想喜欢这个的。真的真的想。玩到某个地方，还在教程里，你盯着一个控制台，就好像你应该拥有游戏里角色的世界内知识一样，但你没有，因为你不是那个角色，而教程毫无必要地含糊不清，与它似乎想要营造的沉浸感脱节，因为它既不沉浸，同时又毫无帮助。

所以我错过了一个我不知道的步骤，它没有告诉我，也没有在我出错时更新我关于什么或哪里出错的信息，只是让我盯着一个屏幕，其杂乱和反直觉程度就像你想象中一个你从未见过的宇宙飞船的控制面板，完全由1993年Sierra冒险游戏的像素构成一样。

同时它播放着可以说是最烦人的高音调、快速、响亮、不间断的哔哔声，完全没有指示如何停止它，除非使用我实际见过并用过的控制来强制退出这个可憎之物。

如果开发者读到这个，而你的目标是制作一个超级沉浸和逼真的科幻太空生存模拟，因为它是“硬核”或什么的而极其困难，那你绝对失败了。

如果你的目标是制作一个超级沉浸和逼真的科幻太空生存模拟，因为你把玩家丢进一个情境中，角色会知道关于复杂事物的基本知识，但本质上却是一个脑损伤的失忆者，因为玩家并没有真正经历角色的历史，在太空中 scavenging 飞船是人们向往的正常事情，而是做了一个多项选择测试，那意味着一些同样没有解释的东西，然后通过基本上对着他们的脸尖叫“”来绝对烦死他们，而他们拼命试图扫描那个带有按钮的杰克逊·波洛克画作，也就是游戏的UI和艺术方向，拼命想让它停下来，结果只能alt-tab出去并强制关闭游戏，同时大喊“F**K！！！”然后立即卸载它。那么，干得好！搞定了。

也许试着让教程更有吸引力，把那个在你发烧做梦时不在你脑子里的玩家带进来，让它不仅仅是额外的杂乱盒子，里面塞满文字，告诉你去点击你从未听说过的东西，或者可能通过看一堆杂乱的东西就能知道的东西。不要用一个比80年代末和90年代初那个带木面板、黑色边框和亮红色发光数字的数字时钟更烦人的警报来惩罚你的潜在玩家群，那个时钟现在正在重新唤醒每一个读到这个的人心中的恐惧和焦虑，他们完全知道我在说哪个时钟。
你在抛出一些会惹恼任何不是完全受虐狂的人的东西，因为他们不知道你打算让你的游戏如何运作，在第一次看到它不到5分钟的时候，原因我只能想象是想要那种前卫/粗犷的“为真正玩家准备的硬核游戏”感觉，像Darksouls曾经有的或CDDA，但相反你只是有令人讨厌且简直糟糕的游戏设计，这更多是疏远玩家而不是鼓励他们探索你游戏中可能非常好的方面。不过我不会知道，我永远不会知道，因为我不会忍受任何像失控的足球妈妈排队买Stanley吸管杯时那样对我尖叫的东西，因为我在第一次尝试时没有按照缺少一个步骤的指示做对某事。祝你好运，真的希望你能改变它，可能有助于那大多是正面的评论。不过注意到这个“发布”于2020年，这意味着它可能有一个专门的粉丝男孩基地，他们嘲笑任何有想法的人，如果那些想法不符合那个很久以前的某个构建，对他们来说是完美的，但你通过做任何改变“毁掉”了它，现在他们留下来对游戏所做的任何其他改变大加抨击，这导致你不想做它们，因为害怕反弹和来自混蛋的普遍倦怠，我可能被认为是其中一个。

而对于任何读到这个的人，如果你们在想“弄清楚事情是挑战的一部分。Git gud”或其他类似的用烂了的装逼废话，我挑战你被迫在没有事先训练的情况下手术切除你几乎肯定已经令人难以忍受的个性中那个自命不凡的混蛋，同时我通过变调的自动调音器反复对着你的脸尖叫“你这样做是因为内心深处你知道如果你死了没人会在乎”，并希望你享受学习这个游戏的像素呕吐菜单/UI地狱景观模拟器的时间，同时我去和你母亲谈谈避孕的重要性，通过使用不是由“这种艺术风格超级酷和时髦但通常只是人们懒惰所以是对眼睛的视觉攻击”剪辑室地板上剩下的像素制成的视觉辅助工具，希望她不会冒险把另一个你带到这个世界上。

然后在你以英雄联盟为主题的床上和她进行自愿且充满激情的性交，使用圣经漏洞避孕法。如果你不知道那是什么，你太年轻了。去问你父亲，等他“出去买烟”回来。
拥有或者CDDA，但相反，你只是拥有令人讨厌且纯粹糟糕的游戏设计，它更多地是在疏远玩家，而不是鼓励他们去探索你游戏中那些可能非常出色的方面。不过我不会知道，也永远不会知道，因为我不会忍受任何像一位失控的足球妈妈在排队买Stanley吸管杯时那样对我尖叫的东西，就因为我第一次尝试时没有做对某事，而说明还缺了一步。祝你好运，真的希望你能改掉它，这可能有助于那篇大多是正面的评测。不过注意到这个“发布”于2020年，这意味着它很可能有一个专门的脑残粉基础，他们会嘲笑任何想法与那个很久以前对他们来说完美无缺的某个构建不一致的人，但你通过做出任何改动“毁掉”了它，现在他们留下来对游戏做出的任何其他改动大加抨击，这导致你因为害怕反弹和普遍因混蛋而精疲力竭而不敢做出改动，而我很可能会被认为是其中一个混蛋。

而对于任何读到这段话、正在想“自己弄明白事情是挑战的一部分。练技术吧”或其他类似被用烂了的装逼废话的人，我挑战你被迫在没有事先训练的情况下，用外科手术般的方式从你几乎肯定已经令人难以忍受的个性中切除那个自命不凡的混蛋，同时我通过音调调高的自动调音器反复在你脸上尖叫“你这样做是因为内心深处你知道如果你死了没人会在乎”，并希望你享受学习这个游戏——这个像素呕吐菜单/UI地狱景观模拟器——的时光，而我去和你母亲谈谈避孕的重要性，通过使用不是由“这种艺术风格超级酷炫时髦但通常只是人们在偷懒所以是对眼睛的视觉攻击”剪辑室地板上剩下的任何像素制成的视觉辅助工具，希望她不要冒险把另一个你带到这个世界上。

然后在你的英雄联盟主题床上和她进行自愿且充满激情的性交，使用圣经漏洞避孕法。如果你不知道那是什么，你还太年轻。等你父亲“出去买烟”回来时去问他。

items.text:
Let me prephrase this with the usual Early Access warning - 
This game is in development.
Buy it if you wanna support it in hopefully becoming a great game.
Don't buy it if you expect a full game without any bugs, with full features and smooth GUIs.

This game is a great space sim and potential RPG (not a whole lot there yet besides the beginnings of some plots).

It has a fantastic vibe, you feel like a poor worker starting out with your tin can of a ship to slowly illegally strip down ships for their components and avoid patrols until you get enough money to buy licenses, expand your ship and pay off your mortgage.

For now it has a bunch of different mechanics, some more complete than others, some buggier than others.
- building your char (stats, skills and customisation)
- doing small one-time jobs (deliver stuff, talk to NPCs, explore wrecks)
- a few different plot lines
- survival elements (pay attention to hunger, thirst and most importantly your air and its mixture)
- ingame ship building
- building systems for automated management of the air in your ship (N2, O2, CO2, temperature)
- power management (reactors, batteries, switches, power cables and consumers)
- hiring and managing a crew
- salvaging of derelicts and selling the parts either through legal means or via the black market (if you can find it)
- meaningful interactions with NPCs (satisfy the social needs of your char and/or your crew, lower accrued fines, unlock the black market, get infos/hint for quests, ...
- inventory tetris on multiple levels (in the world, your inventory and the nested inventories of containers, backpacks and crates)
- real-time fighting system with unarmed close quarter, armed close quarter and ranged, with blocking, dodging and movement
- pausing, slowing down or speeding up of ingame time

Tho be warned it has a steep learning curve and while there is a small tutorial and an ingame documentation, there will be a lot of trial and error.
[b]And a pro tip turn up the autosave frequency, the max amount of autosave and get into a habit of regularly saving manually.[/b] There are some events that can be catastrophic for your playthrough and also some unexpected behaviour and bugs.

So if you can ignore the rough edges you can spend a ton of time and have a lot of fun in the game and slowly building up your tin can into a huge multicrew hauler.
items.text_zh:
让我用通常的抢先体验警告来作为开场白——
这款游戏还在开发中。
如果你想支持它，希望它能成为一款伟大的游戏，那就买吧。
如果你期望一款没有任何bug、功能完整、界面流畅的完整游戏，那就别买。

这款游戏是一款出色的太空模拟游戏，也有潜力成为RPG（目前除了几条剧情的开端之外，内容还不太多）。

它有着绝佳的氛围，你感觉自己就像一个穷苦工人，开着自己的破铁皮船起步，慢慢非法拆解飞船获取零件，躲避巡逻，直到攒够钱买许可证、扩建飞船并还清房贷。

目前它有一堆不同的机制，有些比其他的更完整，有些比其他的bug更多。
- 创建你的角色（属性、技能和自定义）
- 做小型一次性工作（送东西、和NPC交谈、探索残骸）
- 几条不同的剧情线
- 生存元素（注意饥饿、口渴，最重要的是你的空气及其混合比例）
- 游戏内飞船建造
- 用于自动管理飞船内空气（N2、O2、CO2、温度）的建造系统
- 电力管理（反应堆、电池、开关、电缆和用电设备）
- 雇佣和管理船员
- 打捞废弃飞船，并通过合法途径或黑市（如果你能找到的话）出售零件
- 与NPC进行有意义的互动（满足你的角色和/或船员的社会需求，降低累积的罚款，解锁黑市，获取任务信息/提示……）
- 多层级的物品栏俄罗斯方块（世界中、你的物品栏，以及容器、背包和板条箱的嵌套物品栏）
- 实时战斗系统，包括徒手近战、持械近战和远程，带有格挡、闪避和移动
- 暂停、减慢或加快游戏内时间

不过要警告你，它的学习曲线很陡峭，虽然有一个小教程和游戏内文档，但还是会有大量的试错。
[b]还有一个专业提示：调高自动保存频率、自动保存的最大数量，并养成定期手动保存的习惯。[/b]有些事件可能会对你的游玩过程造成灾难性影响，还有一些意外行为和bug。

所以，如果你能忽略这些粗糙的边缘，你就能在这款游戏里花上大量时间，享受很多乐趣，并慢慢把你的破铁皮船建成一艘巨大的多船员运输船。

got overwhelmed by the game's crapload of unique mechanics at the start of my first character, decided to punch a sleeping woman to death instead

update:

My prior review doesn't do justice for Ostranauts, as it understandably has a steep learning curve that needs you to go through at least a single playthrough and lots of reading for guides and tutorials. On my fourth playthrough, having spent 10 hours on getting a grasp on this game (and yet theres still a lot to learn), I decided to edit this review with a proper cricitism and praise Ostranauts deserves.

Getting into this for the first time, especially if you're the kind of person that's obtuse (im one), you're going to get thrown off trying to figure out what to do and eventually get discouraged from playing it further. Deaths from suffocating without oxygen, crashing your ship to someone's, or getting stabbed by pirates (havent experienced this one yet), you'll be tempted to leave this game be and reconsider if it was worth the purchase you did. Even if you haven't died yet in Ostranauts, the complex controls and mechanics you need to learn can be one of the main reasons new players might not play this again.

That's normal! It takes time for some people to take a liking to Ostranauts and play it as it's intended. The game does its best to hold your hand for a good reason, through in-game tutorials that you can follow through every time you launch a new playthrough. The game doesn't expects you to be proficient in everything Ostranauts has to offer, as you will eventually learn everything later in your playthroughs. The humble player community of Ostranauts is friendly too, with many veterans eager to help out new players.

The lore of Ostranauts is absolutely amazing to delve into, carving out the essence Ostranauts makes it out to be. There isn't much to be done for your character's lore though (in gameplay at least), albeit I don't consider it as a flaw of Ostranauts because you're the one to carve out your own story. 

Unlike NEO Scavenger (hello neo scav fans), playing Ostranauts can be incredibly time-intensive. If you think NEO Scavenger wasn't casual, Ostranauts' gameplay will make you think otherwise.

Take your time, be patient, and you'll soon grow to love this game just like how you would love NEO Scavenger.

ps: It's highly recommended that you join player communities of Ostranauts and refer to guides a lot, just so you wouldn't have to go through the phase of frequently quitting Ostranauts over your frustration with it, like me.
items.text_zh:
在第一个角色开局时被游戏一大堆独特的机制搞得不知所措，决定转而把一个熟睡的女人打死

更新：

我先前的评测对《Ostranauts》并不公平，因为它可以理解地有着陡峭的学习曲线，需要你至少完整通关一次，并阅读大量指南和教程。在我的第四次游玩中，在花了10个小时来掌握这款游戏之后（而且仍然有很多要学），我决定编辑这篇评测，给出《Ostranauts》应得的恰当批评与赞扬。

第一次接触这款游戏时，尤其是如果你是那种迟钝的人（我就是），你会被搞得晕头转向，试图弄清楚该做什么，最终会灰心丧气，不想再玩下去。因没有氧气而窒息死亡、把你的飞船撞到别人的飞船上，或者被海盗捅死（这个我还没经历过），你会忍不住想放下这款游戏，重新考虑这次购买是否值得。即使你还没有在《Ostranauts》中死过，你需要学习的复杂操作和机制也可能是新玩家不再玩这款游戏的主要原因之一。

这很正常！有些人需要时间才能喜欢上《Ostranauts》，并按照它应有的方式去玩。游戏尽力牵着你的手是有充分理由的，通过游戏内教程，你每次开始新游玩时都可以跟着走。游戏并不指望你精通《Ostranauts》所提供的一切，因为你最终会在游玩过程中学会一切。谦逊的《Ostranauts》玩家社区也很友好，许多老玩家都热心帮助新玩家。

《Ostranauts》的背景设定绝对值得深入探究，雕琢出了《Ostranauts》所呈现的精髓。不过，你的角色的背景设定并没有太多可做的（至少在玩法上），尽管我不认为这是《Ostranauts》的缺陷，因为你自己就是雕琢自己故事的人。

与《NEO Scavenger》不同（你好，NEO Scav粉丝们），玩《Ostranauts》可能会极其耗时。如果你觉得《NEO Scavenger》不算休闲，那么《Ostranauts》的玩法会让你改变想法。

慢慢来，保持耐心，你很快就会爱上这款游戏，就像你会爱上《NEO Scavenger》一样。

附言：强烈建议你加入《Ostranauts》的玩家社区并多多参考指南，这样你就不必像我一样经历因挫败而频繁弃玩《Ostranauts》的阶段。

items.text: A game with deep systems and a Space Sims experience, it is has a sense of Hardcore like NEO Scav but offers the ability to save (making it much more playable to the average gamer). A great entry in the Blue Bottle catalog and a great game that offers a lot if you give it a little time. Warning like many of Blue Bottle's games it has a Learning Curve TM and hidden events, the best I can recommend is to talk to the community or find some to play along side. 8.75/10 worth the price.

items.text:
-become good at hacking
-steal high-rollers space ship
-wander around space station
-hack random doors, steal scrap and sell it
-extort own father for money, convince him to solve it himself and he[i] still [/i]pays me
-try to make friends with Fixer, hates me
-go back to port to start scrapping
-ship despawned
-jump into space and suffocate to death

10/10 would wander around a space station for 4 hours again

realistically i think the game has tons of depth in my 4 small hours of playtime, but i can see the early access showing. hope this gets fleshed out and developed further cause i see tons of potential. 

things i enjoyed:
- diverse ship function systems (i had two saves, both ended in death lmao)
- multiple ways to solve problems whether it be through rerouting power, hacking or prying open various doors and locks
- the skills system seems very interesting once full fleshed out in the later releases of the game
- booting into the ship for the first time really felt like i was coming across an old piece of space junk that[i] somehow [/i] still manages to fly
- the overall atmosphere, with the music and art style combining very well

things i had some issues with were:
- conversations were either hard to discern what to say or entirely oblivion NPC level convos
- the light levels in the game make it very difficult to make out anything that isnt directly next to you
- if i wanted to load a previous save, i had to exit to main menu, then reload
- game seems either difficult or unintuitive to get started with scrapping derelicts
items.text_zh:
-变得擅长黑客
-偷高滚玩家的飞船
-在空间站四处游荡
-黑入随机的门，偷废料并卖掉
-向自己的父亲勒索钱财，说服他自己解决，而他[i]仍然[/i]付钱给我
-尝试与Fixer交朋友，他恨我
-回到港口开始拆解
-飞船消失了
-跳入太空并窒息而死

10/10 会再次在空间站四处游荡4小时

实际上，我认为在我4个小时的短暂游玩时间里，这款游戏有大量的深度，但我能看出早期访问的痕迹。希望这能得到充实和进一步发展，因为我看到了巨大的潜力。

我喜欢的东西：
- 多样化的飞船功能系统（我有两个存档，都以死亡告终，哈哈）
- 多种解决问题的方式，无论是通过重新路由电力、黑客攻击还是撬开各种门和锁
- 技能系统在游戏后续版本中完全充实后似乎非常有趣
- 第一次启动飞船时，真的感觉像是我遇到了一块旧太空垃圾，它[i]不知怎么地[/i]仍然能飞
- 整体氛围，音乐和艺术风格结合得非常好

我遇到一些问题的地方是：
- 对话要么很难辨别该说什么，要么完全是湮灭NPC级别的对话
- 游戏中的光照水平使得很难辨认任何不直接在你旁边的东西
- 如果我想加载之前的存档，我必须退出到主菜单，然后重新加载
- 游戏似乎要么很难，要么不直观，难以开始拆解废弃飞船

items.text:
*I* love this game. You may not.
It has a very unique art style, and combines Space Station 13, with the Expanse and Hard Space Shipbreaker. 
The visuals can be confusing, the tutorial hints are often vague or entirely absent, it's still very early Access, with some bugs. That being said, it has a decent gameplay loop, pretty good emergent gameplay for being singleplayer, and an interesting, if familiar world. Most of the UI is skeumorphic.

items.text:
The game gives absolutely no information to the player whatsoever about what traits do. It tells you you should take valuable parts of the ship, yet the uninstall takes ages. Upon further research, you require a skill (which you can only guess at if not using the wiki) to improve the time it takes. You start with a pressure suit, which requires you to go back and forth for more air while you dismantle derelicts. While autotask does indeed make the character go on its own, both for uninstalling components and going back to the ship for more air, having high CO2 inside the pressure suit sets the game speed to 1x, effectively making you unable to automate things properly unless you enjoy playing in real time speed.

Some UIs in the game are pretty good to look at, while some contain default Unity slide bars and fully black backgrounds (see refuel UI), many other UIs look out of place and have many different styles, as if each one was made by a different person with different ideas.

This is definitely not a 1.0 game, and I doubt it'll ever be by looking at the pace at which updates are released.

游戏里有些UI看起来相当不错，而有些则包含默认的Unity滑动条和全黑背景（见加油UI），还有许多其他UI显得格格不入，风格五花八门，仿佛每一个都是由不同的人带着不同想法做出来的。

这绝对不是一款1.0版本的游戏，而且从更新发布的速度来看，我怀疑它永远都不会是。

items.text:
Okay. So the idea of this game is beautiful.

But in practice the game is very buggy. Ontop of that extremely hard learning curve and for those searching for instant gratification if any gratification even... This game is not for you.

I have made probably more then 30 characters before actually even learning the basics, from suffocation to extreme debt, even mulled to death by pirates.

The idea of Neoscavengers combat and inventory is very present, but in a different point of view.

I wanna like this game. I find myself forcing myself to play and understand it all in some futile hope to enjoy this game. Somehow I see a part of myself liking it, but I always get to a point that ruins the whole experience through buggy nonsense 9/10 times, actually 10/10 times. You will eventually understand a game plan through killing yourself more then a dozen times. Again very Neoscavenger idea based. But Neoscavenger was perfect for that idea of playstyle. This doesn't feel right though. This feels painful. no matter how much you want to enjoy this game you simply will leave empty handed.

I honestly want to see this game be good, I am sure some of you will even enjoy the game with enough patience. But truthfully most of you won't until bug fixes have been made. Alot of bug fixes.

I also think the game could benefit from a much more narrow introduction? No actually I have no idea how to tackle a tutorial for this game without disturbing the idea of open world sorta freedom vibe it has going on. Which I do think is nice and I enjoy truly, but for someone like myself who had to watch other people on youtube for multiple hours to simply grasp how to place a floor and then in the process !!accidentally!! learn about zones, a tutorial seems sorta mandatory for this game.

But to be clear I like this game. It does make me grit my teeth with the sheer force of will I am required to put into wanting to enjoy it. But I like it. It just needs some love.
items.text_zh:
好吧。所以这个游戏的理念很美。

但实际上，这游戏bug非常多。除此之外，学习曲线极其陡峭，而对于那些追求即时满足、甚至哪怕只是任何一点满足感的人来说……这游戏不适合你。

在我真正学会基础操作之前，我大概已经创建了30多个角色，从窒息而死到背负巨额债务，甚至被海盗磨死。

Neoscavenger式的战斗和物品栏理念非常明显，只是从不同的视角呈现。

我想喜欢这个游戏。我发现自己强迫自己去玩、去理解这一切，抱着某种徒劳的希望，想享受这个游戏。不知怎的，我能看到自己有一部分喜欢它，但我总是会走到某个点，然后十有八九、实际上是十次十次，都被一堆bug般的胡闹毁掉整个体验。你最终会通过把自己弄死十几次来理解一套游戏思路。这又是非常Neoscavenger式的理念。但Neoscavenger对那种玩法理念来说是完美的。这个感觉却不对劲。这感觉痛苦。无论你多想享受这个游戏，你最终只会空手而归。

我真心希望看到这个游戏变好，我相信你们中有些人只要有足够耐心，甚至会喜欢这个游戏。但说实话，在bug修复完成之前，你们大多数人不会。大量的bug修复。

我还觉得这游戏可以从一个更窄的引导中受益？不，其实我完全不知道该怎么给这游戏做教程，又不破坏它那种开放世界式自由氛围的理念。我确实觉得那种氛围很好，也真心喜欢，但对于像我这样不得不在YouTube上看别人好几个小时，才勉强搞懂怎么放一块地板，然后在这个过程中！！不小心！！了解到区域机制的人来说，教程对这游戏似乎算是必需的。

但说清楚，我喜欢这个游戏。它确实让我咬紧牙关，因为我为了想享受它而不得不投入纯粹的意志力。但我喜欢它。它只是需要一些爱。

observations.description: 学习曲线极其陡峭，需要大量试错才能掌握基础
observations.evidence: extremely hard learning curve
observations.evidence_zh: 极其陡峭的学习曲线

items.text:
Ostranauts is an entirely unique and complex space/life sim game. You spend your days as a shipbreaker working off debt you owe to the corporations. You can go out and salvage wrecks from the scrapyard surrounding Kleg Station and bring back components and systems from old damaged ships and sell them back to the corporations to reduce your debt. When your starting ship seems a little too old or small you can build onto it or fix up your own derelict and hope the corps don't catch on. [spoiler] Plus with the upcoming 0.13 hamburger update we can now eat like kings and queens. [/spoiler]

The game can be extremely hard to learn as the game tells you next to nothing about how things work but it's one of those games that's really fun and rewarding to figure out the game mechanics (minus the zone system for selling, nothing in the game explains this and you pretty much need to search the forums for information). As a warning the game can be buggy at times but I haven't encountered anything game breaking and most things can be fixed by saving and loading.
items.text_zh:
Ostranauts是一款完全独特且复杂的太空/生活模拟游戏。你作为拆船工度日，偿还你欠公司的债务。你可以出去从Kleg站周围的废料场打捞残骸，从旧损毁飞船上带回部件和系统，再把它们卖回给公司以减少你的债务。当你初始的飞船看起来有点太旧或太小时，你可以扩建它，或者修好你自己的废弃船，并希望公司不会发现。[剧透]另外，随着即将到来的0.13汉堡更新，我们现在可以像国王和王后一样吃饭了。[/剧透]

这款游戏可能极难学习，因为游戏几乎不告诉你任何东西是如何运作的，但它是那种真正有趣且让人有成就感地弄懂游戏机制的游戏之一（除了销售的区域系统，游戏里没有任何东西解释这个，你几乎需要在论坛上搜索信息）。提醒一下，这款游戏有时会有漏洞，但我还没遇到任何破坏游戏的问题，而且大多数事情都可以通过保存和加载来修复。

items.text:
Edit: After continually seeing updates, I decided to reproach this game and retry.. My initial complaints are all around the tutorial which is fundamentally there to describe these important facts to the user.  A left click is to select and object, clicking upon an object, will pop up one or more 'containers' (inventory dialogs), right clicking is for a contextual menu of actions that the user can do on said object.  What makes the above confusing is that it's introduced at the same time as the tutorial popups, it's hard to distinguish the tutorial popups from the container popups,  and that the floor is considered a 'container' (which for a middle aged stoner was something very challenging to comprehend)

Anyways, for me, once I understood the above, the experience changed for me and I regret my earlier review which was posted out of frustration and a misunderstanding of the interface. 


=================================================

I feel anxious when I play this game because the non standard interface (which IMO is usually standard in top  down isometric strategic titles) frustrates me to the point that I can't even figure out how to complete the tutorial.  I fail to see how this game will succeed unless more effort is put into the tutorial in explaining the non standard interface or that the interface is brought up to today's norms... I saw youtubers play and warn about the interface as well but I purchased anyways believing that it would be a minor irritation.. it's not..
items.text_zh:
编辑：在持续看到更新后，我决定重新审视这个游戏并重试。我最初的抱怨全都围绕教程，教程从根本上是为了向用户描述这些重要事实。左键点击是选择对象，点击对象会弹出一个或多个“容器”（物品栏对话框），右键点击是上下文菜单，用户可以对所述对象执行操作。让上述内容令人困惑的是，它与教程弹窗同时出现，很难区分教程弹窗和容器弹窗，而且地板被认为是一个“容器”（对于一个中年瘾君子来说，这是非常难以理解的）

总之，对我来说，一旦我理解了上述内容，体验就改变了，我后悔我早先的评论，那是在沮丧和对界面误解的情况下发布的。


=================================================

我玩这个游戏时感到焦虑，因为非标准界面（在我看来，通常是俯视等距战略游戏的标准）让我沮丧到甚至无法弄清楚如何完成教程。我看不出这个游戏如何能成功，除非在教程中投入更多努力来解释非标准界面，或者将界面提升到今天的标准……我看到YouTuber玩并警告界面问题，但我还是买了，相信那会是个小烦恼……并不是……

observations.description: 教程未能解释非标准界面，导致无法完成教程
observations.evidence: I can't even figure out how to complete the tutorial
observations.evidence_zh: 我甚至搞不懂怎么完成教程

items.text: games fun but good lord it needs something to teach the player whats going on, not even a tutorial just like a note saying "hey you have a flashlight in your space suit! hey you can buy a crowbar next to the starting stations dock!". there are technically objectives that are i guess meant to teach you the game but theyre broken lmfao. But hey its early access who cares
items.text_zh: 游戏好玩，但天哪，它需要一些东西来教玩家发生了什么，甚至不需要教程，只要像一张便条说“嘿，你的太空服里有手电筒！嘿，你可以在起始空间站码头旁边买一根撬棍！”。技术上有些目标，我猜是为了教你玩这个游戏，但它们坏了，笑死。但嘿，这是抢先体验，谁在乎呢

items.text:
The games pretty janky. Maybe 50% done. It comes with no tutorial, no wiki, no hints on how to start.
Its like singleplayer SpaceStation 13 but without the wacky fun. Or much fun at all.
The game lore and story pages warn of stealing whole ships and getting in trouble with the law, but you cant pirate a ship and sell it off. You sorta have to cut the ship apart and sell it in pieces that fit in your little dinghy all while paying a huge mortgage on that boat four times a day.
The money curve is all off, for a game that tries to be about scavenging ships its more $/hr couriering bottles of vodka and patches between train stations. Safer too since you dont run into odd situations where you become wanted for unknown reasons and slapped with $15k fines when you're trying to get $800 to pay your docking fees. And then you come across a ship with a fusion reactor just sitting there and its worth $100k-200k and poof there goes your money troubles, and the whole point of playing.

Hold off, maybe in a year.
items.text_zh:
这游戏相当粗糙。大概完成了50%。它没有附带教程，没有wiki，没有如何开始的提示。
就像单人版的《SpaceStation 13》，但没有那种古怪的乐趣。或者说根本没什么乐趣。
游戏背景和故事页面警告说偷整艘船会惹上法律麻烦，但你不能劫持一艘船然后卖掉它。你只能把船切开，然后以能装进你那小艇的碎片形式卖掉，同时每天要为你那艘船支付四次巨额抵押贷款。
金钱曲线完全不对，对于一个试图以打捞飞船为主题的游戏来说，它更像是按小时计费在火车站之间运送伏特加酒瓶和补丁。也更安全，因为你不会遇到莫名其妙被通缉、在你试图赚800美元支付停靠费时被罚款15000美元的奇怪情况。然后你遇到一艘带有聚变反应堆的船就停在那里，它价值10万到20万美元，噗，你的金钱烦恼和玩这游戏的全部意义都消失了。

再等等吧，也许一年后。

observations.description: 玩家会在不明原因下变成通缉状态并被罚款
observations.evidence: you dont run into odd situations where you become wanted for unknown reasons and slapped with $15k fines when you're trying to get $800 to pay your docking fees.
observations.evidence_zh: 你不会遇到那种莫名其妙就被通缉的奇怪情况，也不会在你试图赚800来支付停靠费时被罚款15000。

items.text:
I had to restart the game twice because I screwed my self over. Once because I didn't realize there is a docking fee and spent all of my money and the station wouldn't allow me to leave. The second time, I ran out of fuel and didn't have enough money to buy any because there are other fees involved in the purchase. There is definitely a learning curve to this game.

My third game seems to be going a little better after following the tutorial more closely. I think the first time I did something out of order and the tutorial stopped giving me prompts for some reason and I didn't know how I was supposed to be making money.

Will update this review once I've played a little more but it does seem fun once I got past the initial learning phase.
items.text_zh:
我不得不重启游戏两次，因为我把自己的局面搞砸了。一次是因为我没意识到有对接费，把钱全花光了，结果空间站不让我离开。第二次，我燃料用完了，却没有足够的钱买燃料，因为购买还涉及其他费用。这款游戏肯定有学习曲线。

在更仔细地跟着教程走之后，我的第三局游戏似乎进展得好一点了。我觉得第一次我做了一些顺序不对的事，教程不知为何就不再给我提示了，而我不知道自己该怎么赚钱。

等我再多玩一点后会更新这条评测，但一旦熬过最初的学习阶段，它看起来确实很有趣。

observations.description: 学习曲线陡峭，容易因费用和燃料问题失败
observations.evidence: There is definitely a learning curve to this game.
observations.evidence_zh: 这个游戏肯定有一个学习曲线。

items.text: If you are stupid like me, you will not be able to play this game. You have to be a ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ pilot or literal rocket scientist for the tutorial to even remotely make sense.  I couldn't even figure out how to dock my ship after two hours and watching/reading every ship flying guide. I wanted to love this game since I love Neoscavenger, and the concept seems really fun, but at the moment way too confusing for me. Make a mode without the flight sim and I will buy this game again.
items.text_zh: 如果你像我一样蠢，你就玩不了这款游戏。你必须是一个♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥的飞行员或者真正的火箭科学家，教程才能勉强说得通。我甚至花了两个小时、看遍和读遍所有飞船飞行指南之后，还是搞不懂怎么让我的飞船对接。我本想爱上这款游戏，因为我喜欢 Neoscavenger，而且这个概念看起来真的很有趣，但目前对我来说太令人困惑了。做一个没有飞行模拟的模式，我就会再买一次这款游戏。

observations.description: 教程难以理解，无法学会操作
observations.evidence: You have to be a ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ pilot or literal rocket scientist for the tutorial to even remotely make sense.
observations.evidence_zh: 你必须是一个♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥的飞行员或真正的火箭科学家，教程才能勉强说得通。

items.text: Game is very difficult to even make it out of the spawn area.  often tutorials dont even populate after reloading a save to see if you missed something.  tried for almost an hour and never found my ship.  Game leaves too much to be assumed  and with the art style and UI its hard to see just about anything.  I wanted to give it a fair shot but after an hour of struggling i just refunded and got my 20 bucks back.
items.text_zh: 这游戏连离开出生区域都非常困难。经常在重新加载存档看看是否漏掉了什么之后，教程甚至都不出现。试了将近一个小时，也从未找到我的飞船。游戏留下了太多需要猜测的东西，而且以这种美术风格和UI，几乎什么都很难看清。我想给它一个公平的机会，但在挣扎了一个小时后，我还是退款拿回了我的20块钱。

observations.description: 重新加载存档后教程有时不出现
observations.evidence: often tutorials dont even populate after reloading a save to see if you missed something
observations.evidence_zh: 重新加载存档想看看自己是不是漏掉了什么之后，教程往往根本不会出现

items.text:
This has the worst UI I've seen in years. It is tiring to play this.

The way you interact with things is unintuitive. The way you fly your ship is unintuitive. You start out the game with a proximity warning blaring in your ears and your ship in a fierce spin. I've got a headache right now after trying that.

The tutorial is also really bad. The character creation part does looks interesting but you're not really told what anything does, so you're just kind of flailing around.

I'd wait quite a while before picking this up and see what gets done with it.
items.text_zh:
这是我多年来见过的最糟糕的UI。玩这个让人很累。

你与事物互动的方式不直观。你驾驶飞船的方式不直观。你开始游戏时，耳边响着 proximity 警告的刺耳声，飞船在剧烈旋转。试过之后我现在头疼。

教程也非常糟糕。角色创建部分看起来确实有趣，但并没有真正告诉你任何东西是做什么的，所以你只能瞎折腾。

我会等相当长一段时间再入手这个，看看它会被做成什么样。

observations.evidence: The tutorial is also really bad. The character creation part does looks interesting but you're not really told what anything does, so you're just kind of flailing around.

items.text:
Extremely complicated. Nothing is explained. I've died because I didn't understand how docking worked. I've died because I told my character to pry open a crate and he went to get a crowbar from a section of ship that had no atmosphere without a helmet. I've died because I didn't understand the fuel system, ran out of fuel, and just shot across the universe at a relative velocity of 300 meters per second forever without the ability to brake or change directions. I've gotten stuck on a station forever because I couldn't sell my scrap for enough to pay my legal bills and they won't let you leave if you have outstanding fines.

I love it and want to chew on it like a chew toy.
items.text_zh:
极其复杂。什么都没解释。我死过，因为我不明白对接是怎么运作的。我死过，因为我让我的角色撬开一个板条箱，而他却去从一个没有大气层的飞船区域拿撬棍，还没戴头盔。我死过，因为我不明白燃料系统，燃料耗尽，然后以每秒300米的相对速度永远飞越宇宙，无法刹车或改变方向。我曾永远被困在一个空间站上，因为我卖废料赚的钱不够付我的法律账单，而如果你有未缴罚款，他们就不让你离开。

我爱它，想把它像咬咬玩具一样嚼。

não me leve a mal, eu gostei pakas do jogo e joguei bastante antes de comprar com um amigo meu, mas cara... esse jogo não é nem um pouco amigavel pra iniciantes e pra todo mundo em geral, você tem tanta coisa pra controlar ao mesmo tempo, você tem que cuidar da tua nave, enquanto controla ela, enquanto controla seu personagem que tem emoções e que tem necessidades que tem amigos e familia e que tem pessoas que trabalham na nave com ele que também tem suas necessidades e emoções e que além disso tem relacionamentos com você que se tu não tomar cuidado pode acabar zoando com todo seu negocio e além disso tudo o jogo te faz começa com um personagem cheio de debuff que tu tem que tirar usando os poucos anos que teu personagem tem só pra tirar, e sim teu personagem tem idade e quanto mais velho pior, ent ou você começa o jogo com seus belos 18 anos e todo zoado ou você começa aos seus 30 ANOS no minimo pra ter 0 debuffs.

esse jogo é basicamente um chute nas bolas, só compre se tu quer sofrer ou espera ele lança que quem sabe até lá o jogo não bota um tutorial e tira umas mecanicas inuteis tipo as 300 barras sociais e simplifica pra algo mais digestivel.
items.text_zh:
别误会我，我超喜欢这游戏，在和一个朋友一起买之前就玩了很多，但是兄弟……这游戏对新手和所有人来说都一点都不友好，你要同时控制那么多东西，你得照顾你的飞船，一边操控它，一边操控你的角色，角色有情绪、有需求、有朋友和家人，还有和他一起在船上工作的人，那些人也有自己的需求和情绪，除此之外他们还和你有人际关系，如果你不小心，可能会把整个生意都搞砸，而且除此之外，游戏还让你一开始就带着一个满是减益效果的角色，你得用你角色仅剩的几年时间来消除这些减益，是的，你的角色有年龄，越老越糟，所以你要么在18岁开始游戏而且一团糟，要么至少30岁开始才能有0个减益。

这游戏基本上就是往蛋蛋上踹一脚，只有你想受苦才买，或者等它发布，说不定到那时候游戏会加个教程，去掉一些没用的机制，比如那300条社交条，简化成更容易消化的东西。

items.text:
Its definitely a unique experience. The general gameplay loop is flying to derelict ships to explore them and tear out any parts that are valuable to sell so you can pay off the mortgage on your own ship however the game is far too unpolished and obtuse to be worth your time. It definitely has potential but best to wait for a bit.

Very little outside of the basic mechanics of how to fly your ship is explained. Dialogue system seems overly complex with no real depth beyond "choose this option to raise this bar on their side because that benefits me".

Edit: Deleted misinformation
items.text_zh:
这绝对是一种独特的体验。大致的游戏循环就是飞往废弃飞船去探索它们，并拆下任何有价值可出售的部件，这样你就能还清自己飞船的抵押贷款，然而游戏实在太粗糙、太晦涩，不值得你花时间。它绝对有潜力，但最好还是再等等。

除了如何驾驶飞船的基本机制之外，几乎没有任何解释。对话系统似乎过于复杂，却没有真正的深度，无非是“选这个选项来提高他们那边这条进度条，因为这对我有利”。

items.text:
I held off for nearly two years writing this review because I liked NEO Scavenger a lot, and wished with all my heart that this game would come along or I’d come around, whichever first. But it’s simply never happened. Each update makes the game more miserable to play than the last and I don't think any amount of future updates can really address the fundamental issue of sheer antagonism toward the player.

You buy this expecting cool captain shenanigans; [i]yeah, man, I’m going to babysit a bunch of mentally ill crew members on a ship and maybe we’ll go stir crazy and kill each other, I’ll build my ship to look like a dong, wouldn’t that be funny, I'm gonna press all the buttons on the panel heh[/i], etc. But what you get is just… not fun.

Your first hurdle is character creation, where you can’t even see your character well because there is so much graffiti on the mirror. If you want to mod that out, assuming you know how, good luck tracking down ALL the assets to blank them because there’s an entire pool of them that randomizes each time you load a new save. This is, of course, assuming you can find the mirror in the first place as it’s not a clickable object on the wall, you must first have the insane presence of mind to right click the sink, select the sink, then select the mirror from there.

Have you ever made a character in Traveller? If you have, you sort of know already what you’re going to be getting here. If not, well, if you can get through this system that's like trying to ice skate uphill, you can get through character creation in Traveller. You will also find out during this portion that inventory is its own unique burden. Enjoy rerolling to get enough money to afford a backpack, in addition to the other things you do not know you will need to survive later. :)

Let’s fast forward and assume you have done everything “correct”, of which there is an actual correct way to do things in this game though you’d never know it without looking it up and you will probably need to reroll quite a few times to get there. You will now find yourself alone on a ship that needs to be repaired. This is now probably the sixth or seventh time you’ve alt-tabbed out to look up what you’re supposed to do and how to do it. After you’ve surmounted all these obstacles, it’s time to fly!

Flying is somehow worse than walking around. Imagine the floaty drunkenness of Asteroids but now you’re expected to thread a needle every time you want to dock. This is like a gear/skill check boss fight in an MMO, where its mere presence will make you sincerely question your desire to play this game. And you will have to do this every. single. time.

Once you manage to ram your ship into the other ship enough that you accidentally end up docking it, you will not understand how to salvage a ship. You’ll click on things and the game will complain you can’t do this or you don’t have the tool for that or something is too big or there’s no room. Quite tragically, once you figure all this out, you’ll also realise there’s not much else to this game at all.

If your idea of a fun afternoon is trying to solve the Lament Configuration, you'll probably really enjoy this game. But the end result is going to be exactly the same.
items.text_zh:
我拖了将近两年才写下这篇评测，因为我非常喜欢《NEO Scavenger》，并且全心全意地希望这款游戏能有所起色，或者我自己能回心转意，无论哪个先发生。但这一切从未发生。每次更新都让游戏比上一版更令人痛苦，而且我认为再多的未来更新也无法真正解决对玩家极度敌意这个根本问题。

你买这游戏时期待的是酷炫的船长胡闹；[i]是啊，老兄，我要在一艘船上照看一群精神有问题的船员，也许我们会发疯然后互相残杀，我会把我的船造得像个屌，那不好笑吗，我要按下控制面板上所有的按钮嘿嘿[/i]，等等。但你得到的只是……不好玩。

你的第一个障碍是角色创建，你甚至看不清自己的角色，因为镜子上有太多涂鸦。如果你想用模组去掉这些，假设你知道怎么做，祝你好运找到所有素材来清空它们，因为有一整组素材会在你每次加载新存档时随机化。当然，这是假设你能先找到镜子，因为它不是墙上可点击的物体，你必须先有疯狂的镇定，右键点击水槽，选择水槽，然后从那里选择镜子。

你在《Traveller》里创建过角色吗？如果你创建过，你大概已经知道这里会是什么样了。如果没有，那么，如果你能通过这个像试图在斜坡上滑冰一样的系统，你就能通过《Traveller》的角色创建。你还会在这部分发现，物品栏本身就是一种独特的负担。享受反复重掷来获得足够的钱买一个背包吧，此外还有那些你不知道以后生存会需要的其他东西。:)

让我们快进，假设你已经做完了所有“正确”的事，这游戏里确实有一种正确的做事方式，但你不查资料永远不会知道，而且你可能需要重掷很多次才能达到那一步。你现在会发现自己独自在一艘需要修理的船上。这大概已经是你第六次或第七次切出游戏去查你该做什么以及怎么做。在你克服了所有这些障碍之后，是时候起飞了！

飞行不知怎么比走路还糟。想象一下《Asteroids》那种飘忽的醉意，但现在你每次想停靠时都被期望要穿针引线。这就像MMO里的装备/技能检测Boss战，它的存在本身就会让你真心质疑自己想不想玩这个游戏。而且你每次都得这么做。每。一。次。

一旦你设法把你的船撞向另一艘船足够多次，以至于你不小心停靠上了，你也不会明白如何打捞一艘船。你会点击东西，然后游戏会抱怨你不能这么做，或者你没有那个工具，或者某个东西太大，或者没有空间。非常悲剧的是，一旦你搞明白这一切，你也会意识到这个游戏除此之外根本没什么内容。

如果你对一个有趣下午的定义是试图解开哀叹配置盒，你可能会真的很喜欢这个游戏。但最终结果将会完全一样。

observations.description: 不理解如何打捞，点击时游戏报错说无法操作

items.text:
This game has some hard core stuff. Steep Learning Curve. Nav Console requires a freakin' manual to figure out how to fly the ship. Game borders on being a sim with RPG elements.
Also. Space Cops will trash your ship after leaving. "Have a nice day citizen" and then debark by ripping most of your hull away instead of releasing the docking clamps. Clearly there are bugs to be fixed.
items.text_zh:
这款游戏有一些硬核的东西。学习曲线很陡峭。导航控制台需要一本该死的手册才能搞明白怎么驾驶飞船。这游戏几乎算得上是一款带有RPG元素的模拟器了。
另外。太空警察离开后会把你的飞船搞得一团糟。“祝您有美好的一天，公民”，然后不是松开对接夹，而是扯掉你大半的船体就下船了。显然还有bug需要修复。

observations.description: 导航控制台操作复杂，需要手册才能学会驾驶飞船
observations.evidence: Nav Console requires a freakin' manual to figure out how to fly the ship
observations.evidence_zh: 导航控制台需要一本该死的说明书才能搞明白怎么驾驶飞船

items.text:
While the game seems like it has promise, the current version seems unplayably complex having too many complex simulations layered on top of each other before you can even get anywhere, with insufficent tutorialization and feedback.

My playthrough was non-stop confusion. I definitely crashed my ship at least once trying to get to a derelict, and then when I got there I was confounded by the door and lack of lighting and O2. Evenutally I realized that you have a light and vac suit in your inventory (I had been looking for them in/near the airlock) and I eventually figured out that I can pick up items off the ground, but I was unable to figure out how to dismantle ship systems and then kept getting caught by a patrol boat and didn't feel like dealing with yet another minigame while I was still trying to figure out how looting/salvaging a ship worked. The game needs to manage complexity better.
items.text_zh:
虽然这款游戏看起来很有前途，但当前版本似乎复杂到无法游玩，在你甚至还没能取得任何进展之前，就有太多复杂的模拟系统层层叠加在一起，教程和反馈也不够充分。

我的游玩过程就是不停地在困惑中度过。我在试图前往一艘废弃飞船时至少撞毁了自己的飞船一次，然后当我到达那里时，又被门、缺乏照明和氧气搞得一头雾水。最终我意识到自己的物品栏里有一盏灯和一件宇航服（我之前一直在气闸门里/附近找它们），我最终也弄明白了可以捡起地上的物品，但我无法弄清楚如何拆解飞船系统，然后不断被巡逻艇抓住，而在我还在试图弄清楚如何掠夺/打捞一艘飞船的时候，实在不想再应付又一个小游戏。这款游戏需要更好地管理复杂性。

observations.description: 游戏过于复杂，模拟层过多，难以推进。
observations.evidence: the current version seems unplayably complex having too many complex simulations layered on top of each other before you can even get anywhere
observations.evidence_zh: 当前版本似乎复杂到无法游玩，在你甚至还没能取得任何进展之前，就有太多复杂的模拟层层叠加在一起

observations.description: 玩家对游戏机制感到困惑，如无法找到物品、拆卸系统等。
observations.evidence: I was unable to figure out how to dismantle ship systems
observations.evidence_zh: 我无法弄清楚如何拆解飞船系统

items.text:
Lots of baking still needed.

No idea what I'm doing in this game, short of repairing ships.  What few YouTube tutorials I am finding are not terribly helpful.

Gameplay:
Why is there a social mechanism, how does it work, why do I need it?
I think I can get a crew, but why?  How do they help me or do I just pay them for stuff I could just do myself?
Why does everything appear to cost more than I can manage to earn?
Why is the space police constantly fining me and taking my stuff?!


I can't find answers to these things.  Even though this game looks very very interesting, it's just not ready to be played.
items.text_zh:
还需要大量烘焙。

除了修理飞船之外，我完全不知道自己在游戏里做什么。我能找到的少数YouTube教程也没什么太大帮助。

玩法：
为什么会有社交机制，它怎么运作，我为什么需要它？
我想我能弄到一队船员，但为什么？他们怎么帮助我，还是我只是花钱雇他们来做我自己就能做的事？
为什么所有东西看起来都比我设法赚到的钱更贵？
为什么太空警察不断罚我款并拿走我的东西？！


我找不到这些问题的答案。尽管这游戏看起来非常非常有趣，但它还没准备好可供游玩。

observations.description: 社交、船员、经济等机制缺乏说明
observations.evidence: Why is there a social mechanism, how does it work, why do I need it?
observations.evidence_zh: 为什么会有社交机制，它是怎么运作的，我为什么需要它？

items.text:
Has promise but its isn't there yet.  Navigation is a giant PITA and it have lovely bugs like, I can't undock from the totally destroyed ship I'm looting because I owe a fine that I can't pay because I'm not at a station. I recommend giving it a pass until it's not constantly throwing game breaking nonsense.

******
This was more than half my own fault in not realizing the cash read out was the button to the cash app.  I was looking in the PDA, in the nav console for a comm function etc.  
******

This game is definitely worth playing. I suspect it will only grow in complexity and things to do and explore.

It seems to be as much open world as you can ask for, but figuring out some of the logic (which ship components need to be adjacent to a conduit and which need to be ON a conduit to work etc.) has been challenging.  

If you're not put off by rogue-likes and occasionally learning by dying (a tradition from way back in adventure games), and like an open world, I recommend giving it a whirl.  I expect the game play will only deepen and expand as work continues on it.  

I'm not over the learning curve yet but I've managed to figure out how to  repair and expand a ship, schmooze someone into joining as crew and how to pilot the ship (though like a pensioner who can't really see over the steering wheel).

The biggest compliment I can give it thus far is even though I was extremely frustrated trying to figure out how to do things I knew were possible and having several cases of terminal stupidity, I couldn't help but boot up another spacer lemur and giving it another go (and another...).
items.text_zh:
有潜力，但还没到位。导航是个巨大的麻烦，而且它还有些可爱的bug，比如，我没法从正在搜刮的那艘彻底损毁的船上脱离对接，因为我欠了一笔罚款，而我付不了，因为我不在空间站。我建议先跳过它，直到它不再不断抛出破坏游戏的胡闹为止。

******
这更多是我自己的错，我没意识到现金读数就是通往现金应用的按钮。我当时在PDA里、在导航控制台里找通讯功能之类的。
******

这游戏绝对值得一玩。我怀疑它只会变得越来越复杂，有越来越多可做和可探索的事情。

它似乎已经是你所能要求的那种开放世界了，但弄清楚其中一些逻辑（哪些飞船组件需要与导管相邻，哪些需要位于导管上才能工作等等）一直很有挑战性。

如果你不被roguelike游戏和偶尔靠死亡来学习（冒险游戏由来已久的传统）劝退，并且喜欢开放世界，我建议你试一试。我预计随着开发继续，玩法只会加深和扩展。

我还没完全度过学习曲线，但我已经设法弄明白了如何修理和扩建一艘飞船，如何说服某人加入成为船员，以及如何驾驶飞船（尽管像个看不清方向盘前方的养老金领取者）。

到目前为止我能给它的最大赞美是，尽管我在试图弄明白那些我知道可能做到的事情时极度沮丧，还经历了好几次致命的愚蠢，我还是忍不住又启动了一只太空狐猴，再试一次（又一次……）。

observations.description: 不清楚哪些船部件需要相邻或放在导管上才能工作
observations.evidence: figuring out some of the logic (which ship components need to be adjacent to a conduit and which need to be ON a conduit to work etc.) has been challenging

items.text:
I literally don't understand what I'm doing. But the art, sounds, and style are pretty cool. I feel immediately overwhelmed with options in the character creation area. I have no idea how to navigate my ship properly. It's cool that I crashed and died immediately, I think I need more practice in the character creation area anyway.

Update 3.5 years later: This game is a hot mess of interfaces and stuff. I still can't figure what the hell is going on. But everybody says it's a really good game. I trust them. See you in a few more years.
items.text_zh:
我真的不明白自己在做什么。但美术、音效和风格都挺酷的。在角色创建区域，我立刻就被各种选项淹没了。我完全不知道如何正确地驾驶我的飞船。我立刻坠毁并死掉这件事挺酷的，我想反正我需要在角色创建区域多练习一下。

3.5年后的更新：这游戏就是一堆界面和东西的烂摊子。我还是搞不懂到底发生了什么。但大家都说这是款非常好的游戏。我相信他们。几年后再见。

observations.evidence: I feel immediately overwhelmed with options in the character creation area.
observations.evidence_zh: 我在角色创建区域立刻就被各种选项淹没了。

observations.description: 不知道如何正确驾驶飞船
observations.evidence: I have no idea how to navigate my ship properly.
observations.evidence_zh: 我完全不知道如何正确地驾驶我的飞船。

items.text:
I'm sorry, maybe I'm really ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ stupid or not patient enough but even with the in game manual and the community made first flight guide I cannot seem to grasp the concept of how to actually make my ship fly, and the frustration ruins any immersion or fun the game might otherwise provide me. It just throws me in without any basics on game controls or mechanics, as if I'm supposed to know already. I feel like this game might benefit from a guiding tutorial of how to fly the ship, or even a mode to simplify it for people who want to experience the rest of the game but not have the ship flying be like 90% of the focus.
I want to play this game and enjoy it but I feel like it's not For Me because of the complicated game mechanics and it's disappointing.
items.text_zh:
抱歉，也许我真的♥♥♥♥♥♥♥太蠢了，或者不够有耐心，但即使有游戏内手册和社区制作的首飞指南，我似乎还是无法理解如何真正让我的飞船飞起来，而这种挫败感破坏了游戏本来可能带给我的任何沉浸感或乐趣。它就这样把我扔进去，没有任何关于游戏控制或机制的基础说明，好像我本就应该知道似的。我觉得这款游戏可能会受益于一个指导性的教程，教人如何驾驶飞船，甚至是一个简化模式，为那些想体验游戏其余部分、但不希望飞船驾驶成为90%焦点的人准备。
我想玩这款游戏并享受它，但我觉得它不适合我，因为游戏机制太复杂了，这让人失望。

observations.evidence_zh: 它直接把我扔进去，没有任何关于游戏控制或机制的基础说明，就好像我应该已经知道了一样

items.text: Before you buy, just know, this game is not easy. There is a huge learning curve. You will either have to luck out on getting in-game reading material that helps explain, or find outside help. Now with that out of the way, this is one of the most interesting games I've played in a while. While playing in early access I can see room for growth, but still has a playable game. Traversing space, docking with derelicts, and scavenging for profit or to make your own vessel. This is an amazing game, with lots of potential. I cannot wait to see the final product.
items.text_zh: 在你购买之前，只要知道，这款游戏并不简单。学习曲线非常陡峭。你要么得靠运气获得能帮助解释的游戏内阅读材料，要么就得找外部帮助。现在把这点说清楚了，这是我一段时间以来玩过的最有趣的游戏之一。在抢先体验中游玩时，我能看到成长空间，但它仍然是一款可玩的游戏。穿越太空、与废弃飞船对接，并为了利润或建造自己的飞船而打捞。这是一款很棒的游戏，潜力巨大。我迫不及待想看到最终成品。

observations.description: 学习曲线陡峭，缺乏游戏内教学说明
observations.evidence: There is a huge learning curve. You will either have to luck out on getting in-game reading material that helps explain, or find outside help.

items.text:
I'm going to be honest i bought this game as soon as i had the money to after it came out.
disappointed would be a strong word i get that the point of this game is to be semi realistic and challenging experience but frankly it seems like the only difficulty comes from a nightmarish in game interface that spoils what fun there is to be had in it, not in an interesting fashion but really a very mundane unpolished sort of way. i loved neo scavenger but neo scavenger was both simpler and felt like it worked the way it was meant to.
i just cant tell if things in this are even working and the feed back the game gives is almost non existent half the time i find out the thing i'm experiencing are bugs and when they are not its just that the game makers felt it was alright to arbitrarily make things less functional as an artificial increase to game difficulty at the cost of fun. maybe when its all finished ill come back but i regret getting this game as it is now.
items.text_zh:
老实说，这游戏一出我就有钱立刻买了。
说失望可能有点重，我明白这游戏的重点就是半写实和充满挑战的体验，但坦白说，唯一的难度似乎来自一个噩梦般的游戏界面，它破坏了本可以有的乐趣，不是以有趣的方式，而是非常平庸、粗糙的那种。我很喜欢《新拾荒者》，但《新拾荒者》既更简单，又感觉它按本该有的方式运作。
我就是分不清这里面的事情到底有没有在正常运作，游戏给出的反馈几乎不存在，一半时间我发现我遇到的事情是bug，而当它们不是bug时，就只是游戏制作者觉得可以随意让东西变得不那么好用，作为人为增加游戏难度的手段，牺牲了乐趣。也许等它全部完成时我会回来，但我后悔现在买了这游戏。

items.text:
This game is only suitable for a specific group of gamers. 
I think people who liked Neo Scavenger will also like this one. 

It reminds me of good old C64 times.  The manual is useless, and there are barely any ingame hints. There is a readme file in the main folder with some essentials, but actually it is quite fun to figure things out yourself. 
 
Currently the game runs quite stable, although I had one catastrophic failure that destroyed my save game. There are backups available, but make sure to make extra copies as these backups can get corrupted, too. 

Despite the missing content this game is quite some fun already now. 
It was quite annoying to find those leaks. I spend an hour to spot that last leak hidden which pointed out to be a damaged floor hidden under a battery. With the recent update it became much easier to spot those leaks. 
There seems to be limit on how much you can carry, so you can stack crates into each other and basically carry a whole starship around. Easy enough to scrap one hopelessly damaged ship and use the parts to repair a decent one.  

I have not figured out yet how to recruit another crew member. I guess my chosen character traits were too bad for that strange "socializing" combat game.
items.text_zh:
这款游戏只适合特定的一群玩家。
我觉得喜欢《Neo Scavenger》的人也会喜欢这款游戏。

它让我想起了美好的C64时代。手册毫无用处，游戏内的提示也几乎没有。主文件夹里有一个readme文件，里面有一些要点，但实际上自己摸索出东西来还挺有趣的。

目前游戏运行相当稳定，尽管我遇到过一次灾难性故障，毁掉了我的存档。有备份可用，但一定要额外多复制几份，因为这些备份也可能损坏。

尽管内容有所缺失，这款游戏现在就已经相当有趣了。
找出那些泄漏点相当烦人。我花了一个小时才找到最后那个隐藏的泄漏点，结果发现是藏在电池下面的一块损坏地板。随着最近的更新，找出这些泄漏点变得容易多了。
携带量似乎有上限，所以你可以把箱子套进彼此里面，基本上能带着一整艘星际飞船到处跑。把一艘彻底损坏的飞船拆解掉，用零件修好一艘还不错的飞船，这足够简单。

我还没搞明白怎么招募另一名船员。我猜我选择的角色特质对那个奇怪的“社交”战斗游戏来说太差了。

observations.description: 未弄清如何招募船员
observations.evidence: I have not figured out yet how to recruit another crew member
observations.evidence_zh: 我还没弄明白怎么招募另一名船员

items.text:
EDIT: Ostranauts has evolved a lot since it launched in early access, the social interaction ''combat'' mechanics are truly unique and add so much flavour to the roleplay.
You play as a simple employee on the K-leg space station and you managed to save up enough money to buy your own salvage ship however, it is no easy life. The mortgage on your ship basically locks you into an infinite debt and the only way to escape it is to outsmart the many regulations imposed by the totalitarian corporations that control the graveyard.

Release day review: ''Duskers but with colours, people and a bunch of control panels with a bunch of functions. Even barebone it's a delight however the starting points either get you through the first few steps or nowhere at all.

To experiment the game features and mechanics better make sure you have a good starting character with not many flaws and at least  few thousand $

Definitely worth the Early Access.''
items.text_zh:
编辑：自《Ostranauts》在抢先体验版推出以来，它已经发展了很多，社交互动“战斗”机制真正独特，为角色扮演增添了太多风味。
你扮演K-leg空间站上的一名普通员工，你设法攒够了钱买下自己的打捞船，然而，这并非轻松的生活。你船上的抵押贷款基本上把你锁在无限债务中，唯一摆脱它的方法就是智胜控制着坟场的极权公司 imposed 的众多法规。

发布日评测：“《Duskers》但有颜色、有人，还有一堆带有一堆功能控制面板。即使简陋，也是一种乐趣，然而起始点要么让你走过最初几步，要么完全走不通。

为了更好地体验游戏特性和机制，确保你有一个没有太多缺陷的好起始角色，并且至少有几千美元

绝对值得抢先体验。”

items.text: El juego es genial en cuanto ideas, pero todavia hay mecanicas mal desarrolladas y bugs que pueden arruinar una partida, es extremadamente dificil cumplir siquiera el primer objetivo del juego (conseguir una nave decente). Aun asi habiendo jugado Neo Scavenger tengo fe de que cuando llegue 1.0 sera un juego genial. Por ahora mejor dejarlo en la lista de deseados y esperar a que llegue la 1.0
