items.text:
Like the others say, the game has bugs and a lack of content. But I believe, based on my experience with watching Neo Scavenger, that the game will eventually be excellent. 

The game starts with your character on a ship where you can choose your characters gender and pronouns. You can also randomize the avatar's face but I don't believe customization is in the game. You continue by choosing your career and answering a questionnaire about how you deal with particular situations nets your character skills and money. Once you complete that you can use some of the money to buy equipment for work. Currently it is somewhat limited with a crowbar, laser system (that I wasn't able to figure out how to use), work flashlight, food (which gave one of my characters food allergies and killed them). You can also choose the characters attributes like strong, feeble, genius. I'm uncertain at this time how much of an affect this plays on the game but I know that the food sensitivity one works as do some of the ones that govern your character's emotions.

Once you've done all of that, you can finalize your character and launch on your space ship. When you do that you are transitioned from the starting area to a small single room ship. Currently there is no tutorial so you'll need to click around and figure out how to do certain things. Sitting at the Navigation chair allows you to pilot your ship while looking at a cool 70s (think Ridley Scott's Aliens) terminal. You can lock on to a specific destination and fly over to it. This requires some skill as it is kind of easy to rotate uncontrollably until you get a feel for the controls. Once you get close to your target a proximity klaxon will start beeping as your increase your distance. You switch over to docking mode, connect to the target and dock your ship. Docking relies on you lining up your ship so that the docking clamps can connect. This isn't too hard unless you are moving too fast. 

Having connected successfully to the derelict ship, the time has come for you to go and scavenge for parts. Because your character is new and doesn't have a lot of money, you are initially required to scavenge in lunges because you don't have the EVA suit and when you put on your space suit, you only have air for a couple of minutes so you have to get into the derelict, uninstall whatever scrap you want and then get back to your ship before passing out and dying. If you manage to get this far you will come to the only problem I've found with the game so far. 

Your ship, until you find a generator, runs on batteries that drains as your ship produces thrust, heats the interior, produces air, et al. Once that drains down all power is shut off on board your ship and you can no longer control whichever direction you are going in or even see how far other things are. Additionally, there isn't a way (that I have found) to recharge the batteries. So in my case I was able to make one derelict run and then had to head back to the K-leg (first space station) where I became marooned because I couldn't figure out how to get more energy for my ship. I was able to make a decent amount of money selling the scrap that I had taken from the derelict though and bought more drinks and food.

While stuck at the station I was able to talk to the other friendly NPCs and test out the interaction/diplomacy screen. You are able to recruit other characters to join your crew but since you don't have beds, restroom facilities, etc I can't see how it would help. 

 I am recommending the game but I would say wait for the Developer to release a patch fixing the biggest issues and then go ahead and buy the game if you are interested in a hardish science fiction space game.
items.text_zh:
就像其他人说的那样，这款游戏有bug，内容也不足。但根据我观看《Neo Scavenger》的经验，我相信这款游戏最终会非常出色。

游戏开始时，你的角色在一艘飞船上，你可以选择角色的性别和代词。你还可以随机化头像的面部，但我认为游戏中没有自定义功能。接着你选择职业，并回答一份关于你如何应对特定情况的问卷，这会为你的角色提供技能和金钱。完成这些后，你可以用一些钱购买工作装备。目前装备有些有限，包括一根撬棍、激光系统（我没能弄明白怎么用）、工作手电筒、食物（这让我其中一个角色得了食物过敏并死了）。你还可以选择角色的属性，比如强壮、虚弱、天才。目前我不确定这对游戏有多大影响，但我知道食物敏感属性是有效的，还有一些控制角色情绪的属性和有效。

完成所有这些后，你可以最终确定你的角色并发射你的太空船。当你这样做时，你会从起始区域过渡到一个小型单间飞船。目前没有教程，所以你需要四处点击来弄清楚如何做某些事情。坐在导航椅上可以让你驾驶飞船，同时看着一个很酷的70年代风格（想想雷德利·斯科特的《异形》）终端。你可以锁定一个特定目的地并飞过去。这需要一些技巧，因为在你熟悉控制之前，很容易不受控制地旋转。一旦你接近目标，随着距离增加，一个接近警报器会开始发出哔哔声。你切换到对接模式，连接到目标并停靠你的飞船。对接依赖于你将飞船对齐，以便对接夹能够连接。这不太难，除非你移动得太快。

成功连接到废弃飞船后，是时候去搜寻零件了。因为你的角色是新手，没有很多钱，你最初需要分次搜寻，因为你没有EVA宇航服，而当你穿上太空服时，你只有几分钟的空气，所以你必须进入废弃飞船，卸下你想要的任何废料，然后在昏倒和死亡之前回到你的飞船。如果你设法走到这一步，你会遇到我目前发现的游戏中唯一的问题。

你的飞船，在你找到发电机之前，靠电池运行，当你的飞船产生推力、加热内部、产生空气等时，电池会耗尽。一旦电池耗尽，飞船上的所有电源都会关闭，你不再能控制你前进的方向，甚至看不到其他东西有多远。此外，我没有找到给电池充电的方法。所以在我的情况下，我只能进行一次废弃飞船之旅，然后不得不返回K-leg（第一个空间站），在那里我因为无法弄清楚如何为飞船获取更多能量而被困。不过，我通过出售从废弃飞船上拿到的废料赚了不少钱，并买了更多饮料和食物。

被困在空间站时，我能够与其他友好的NPC交谈，并测试互动/外交界面。你能够招募其他角色加入你的船员，但既然你没有床、洗手间设施等，我看不出这有什么帮助。

我推荐这款游戏，但我会说等开发者发布补丁修复最大的问题，然后如果你对一款偏硬核的科幻太空游戏感兴趣，就去买吧。

items.text:
Update 2: It's definitely possible to have adventures, but it's still a bit buggy.

For some reason there's a tooltip around your cursor that never goes away once it's there, and it doesn't really seem to be meaningful what it's there for.

The tutorial, while more helpful than the last one, misses important steps. Like putting on a pressure suit and helmet before getting into a small tug that has no atmosphere past the airlock at all (despite it seeming that way to a newbie).

There's definitely more stuff to do. Dialogue has become a bit more painful in my opinion than it was, due to all the available fighting options. It feels like that's going to result in some unintentional fisticuffs at some point.

Summary: It's getting closer to a recommendation, but it's obviously not done yet. Pick it up if you want to play around with a fairly advanced topdown space simulation game with some nice flavour, but expect it to be a bit buggy/hard to understand.

Update: Things are looking and feeling a lot more playable now. I haven't done much yet, but if it turns out you can have a full on adventure without too many bugs, I might flip this to a "Yes" - though there's clearly a lot more to be done.

Original: I'm sure this game will improve over time, as there is lots of potential -- but right now, I can't progress past the "salvage pod" stage, as I can't seem to get navigation to work at all. I had a similar problem in the demo launched a few weeks ago as well, but figured this bug would be ironed out before the EA release.

As things are *right now*, it's not recommended that anyone buy this game if not for supporting the developer.
items.text_zh:
更新2：绝对有可能展开冒险，但还是有点bug。

不知为何，你的光标周围有一个提示框，一旦出现就永远不会消失，而且它到底为什么在那里似乎也没什么意义。

教程虽然比上一个更有帮助，但遗漏了重要步骤。比如在进入一艘小型拖船之前要穿上压力服和头盔，而那艘拖船在气闸之外根本没有大气（尽管对新手来说看起来像是有的）。

确实有更多事情可做了。在我看来，由于所有可用的战斗选项，对话变得比之前更痛苦了。感觉这迟早会导致一些非本意的拳脚相向。

总结：它越来越接近值得推荐了，但显然还没做完。如果你想玩一款相当进阶、带有一些不错风味的俯视角太空模拟游戏，那就入手吧，但要做好它有点bug/难以理解的准备。

更新：现在看起来和感觉起来都更可玩了。我还没做太多，但如果结果证明你可以在没有太多bug的情况下展开一场完整的冒险，我可能会把它改成“是”——不过显然还有很多工作要做。

原文：我相信这款游戏会随着时间推移而改进，因为它很有潜力——但现在，我无法通过“打捞舱”阶段，因为我似乎完全没法让导航运作起来。几周前发布的试玩版里我也遇到过类似问题，但以为这个bug会在EA发布前被解决。

就*现在*的情况而言，除非是为了支持开发者，否则不建议任何人购买这款游戏。

items.text:
While I'd recommend the game, it might not be for everyone (or most) in its current state. This is early, almost too early, access right now. It's basically the demo available to play during the Summer Steam Game Festival with slightly more content and polish. It's buggy, the learning curve is steep, there's no tutorial to help you avoid the countless dead characters you will collect while trying to get your salvage pod to a derelict nearby, and the game is unforgiving when it comes to killing you off for mistakes. It's bad enough to make me consider save scumming so I don't have to re-roll my character every couple of minutes, at least until I know what the hell I'm even doing. :)

If this sounds like "fun" to you... get it. If not I'd highly recommend you wait.

items.text:
-install game
-first thing I'm asked about in the character creator is my pronouns
-have to randomize my character until I get someone that doesn't look like a retarded zoomer
-go through career
-one of the events has me seduce someone I don't know the name of, find out afterwards it's a dude, so I guess my character is gay now (apparently spent a good year getting bum bandited by him)
-finally get to my salvage pod and set course for a derelict ship
-the spaceship controls that Fedor made look so cool in his dev videos are some of the most unintuitive and clunky controls I've tried in a video game
-before I manage to get to the derelict, my pod runs out of battery power and everything goes dark
-after two restarts I realize there's an extra battery I can install for more juice (why this isn't installed from the get-go is beyond me)
-this has to be placed facing in the correct direction or it won't work (something that there's no indication of besides some tiny arrows on the battery itself)
-with my newfound power, I head for the derelict again
-crash into it, destroying my pod and asphyxiating my character
-manage after a few more restarts to dock with a derelict
-is confronted by a pitch-black hallway with locked crates and a door I can't open because I didn't buy a crowbar at the start shop (something that there isn't any indication of that you should do)
-while I'm trying to reroute conduits to power the door, my pod runs out of juice again
-alt+F4 and restart again again again
-this time around the derelict that I reach already have the door open
-manage to fire up the reactor and get power
-start pulling up floor from a room I don't need in order to fix the holes in the hull since I didn't get hull patches from the shop (again, game did not tell me I should do this)
-go back to salvage pod to replenish air in suit
-the temperature inside my pod is 78 sextillion kelvin, and the pressure is 22 sextillion kilopascal for some universe-bending reason
-die from organ failure
-rage, alt+F4, and go write this review

Game is offensively unready for even early access.

Fedor, if you read this, cut ties with the woke publisher you've signed up with for some ungodly reason, purge the entire game of any woke ♥♥♥♥, and go back and crunch out the bugs for another half a year before releasing this again. This is just insulting.
items.text_zh:
-安装游戏
-在角色创建器里，第一件被问到的事就是我的代词
-不得不随机化我的角色，直到随机出一个看起来不像弱智Z世代的人
-经历职业生涯
-其中一个事件让我去勾引一个我连名字都不知道的人，事后才发现那是个男的，所以我想我的角色现在是同性恋了（显然还跟他被爆菊了整整一年）
-终于到达我的打捞舱，设定航线前往一艘废弃飞船
-费多尔在他的开发视频里让飞船操控看起来那么酷，实际却是我在电子游戏里试过的最不直观、最笨重的操控之一
-还没等我到达那艘废弃飞船，我的舱就没电了，一切陷入黑暗
-重启两次后我才意识到有一块额外的电池可以安装来获得更多电量（为什么这玩意不是一开始就装好的，我实在想不通）
-这东西必须朝向正确的方向放置，否则就不会工作（除了电池本身上的几个小箭头之外，没有任何提示）
-带着新获得的电力，我再次前往那艘废弃飞船

-当我正试图改接导管给门供电时，我的舱又没电了
-alt+F4，再次重启，再次，再次，再次
-这一次，我到达的那艘废弃飞船门已经是开着的
-成功启动反应堆并恢复供电
-开始从一个我不需要的房间里撬起地板，用来修补船体上的破洞，因为我没从商店买船体补片（同样，游戏没告诉我应该这么做）
-回到打捞舱给宇航服补充空气
-出于某种扭曲宇宙的原因，我的舱内温度是78乘10的21次方开尔文，气压是22乘10的21次方千帕
-死于器官衰竭

这游戏连抢先体验都远远没准备好，简直冒犯。

费多尔，如果你读到这个，赶紧跟那个你不知为何签下的觉醒出版商断绝关系，把游戏里所有觉醒的♥♥♥都清除干净，然后回去再埋头苦干半年修bug，再重新发布这游戏。这简直是在侮辱人。
